The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child. For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world. "With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

116002.item_desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
116002.item_bg_desc: Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?" The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did." Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence. Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality. Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind. "With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

item_comefrom.desc: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 2

116003.item_desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. An advanced material used for enhancement.
116003.item_bg_desc: Every story worth taking seriously shares the same theme: "How to live the one life we're given." Life is so short that even the greatest sages are suddenly tossed into this world, forced to experience a lifetime without any preparation. That is why no one ever lives a perfect life. There are always regrets, always moments wasted. But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. And in stories, we can reach immortality from within our finite cages. "With stories, we are able to live a thousand lifetimes."

item_comefrom.desc: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 4

120000.item_desc: The cryptocurrency circulating internally in the Herta Space Station. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
120000.item_bg_desc: Hertareum was planned as a digital currency, but eventually settled as a physical currency.\nIt's worth mentioning that even though Hertareum coins don't contain any precious metal components, the high-definition silhouette Non-Fungible Token contained inside it is much more valuable than any of them.

120001.item_desc: The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
120001.item_bg_desc: After a long era of blockades, the Overworld and Underworld denizens of Belobog have developed vastly different standards for currency.\nThe current exchange rate of shield to credits is now 1:<unbreak>50</unbreak>... Speaking of, why are credits still an official currency of Belobog? It seems people have already forgotten the answer to this question.

120002.item_desc: The internal currency of the Xianzhou Alliance with strales as its basic monetary unit. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
120002.item_bg_desc: The Xianzhou strales have long been digitized before Xianzhou's interactions with the IPC ever happened. However, there are some collectors who still kept the Celest-Gold coins minted when the Alliance first came into existence. Shaped like the tip of an arrow or a narrow leaf, it seems to allude to the past and future of that civilization.

120003.item_desc: This is said to be a commemorative currency issued personally by the Watchmaker. Can only be used at the Clockie Statue.
120003.item_bg_desc: A mysterious banknote, whose origin is unknown even to The Family. It features the classic image of Clockie on the front. This currency is prohibited for regular transactions in the Dreamscape world, and only a few people know its true purpose.

120004.item_desc: It was said that even Titans covet this ambrosial libation. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
120004.item_bg_desc: The absolute finest of Amphoreus' thousand ambrosias. A golden, sweet nectar. It is said to come from the divine corpus of the Chalice of Plenty spilled onto the earth, making it the perfect offering to the Titans. Just a few drops are enough to inebriate a mortal with its rich fragrance. Consuming it on its own leads to unconsciousness, as if one is drowning in a vast ocean.

120005.item_desc: A liquid that exists outside temporal order. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
120005.item_bg_desc: A precious drink that was once considered "Celestial Ambrosia" in worldly cognition. As the cycles of Amphoreus were revealed, so did the truth of this drink. The scent wafting out of the bottle's mouth seems even more intense and sweeter than before, but imbibing is still not recommended.

120006.item_desc: A commemorative coin used in Planarcadia and Astropolis, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.
120006.item_bg_desc: The local currency of Planarcadia, minted and issued by the Wishpower Bank after being infused with Wishpower. The front depicts various imagenae living together in harmony. In the face of a digital economy, the Arcadian Token maintains its prestigious status among tourists and collectors for its unique blend of cultural sentiment and economic value.\nPursuant to the "Vehicle City Accord" ratified in Year 1985 of the Arcadian Calendar, universal equivalents tied to Wishpower are permitted to circulate in Astropolis as well.

122000.item_bg_desc: A token for amusement facilities at Aideen Park. Despite their large size, they are exceptionally lightweight.\n\nQ: What is something that the more you possess, the less wealth you have? A: Gambler's chips.

122001.item_name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Forgotten Hall
122001.item_desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Forgotten Hall this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
122001.item_bg_desc: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

122002.item_name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Pure Fiction
122002.item_desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Pure Fiction this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
122002.item_bg_desc: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

122003.item_name: Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Apocalyptic Shadow
122003.item_desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Apocalyptic Shadow this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
122003.item_bg_desc: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

122004.item_desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in the King Stage of Anomaly Arbitration of this period.
122004.item_bg_desc: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

123000.item_desc: Can be used to open the Relic Chest in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
123000.item_bg_desc: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

123002.item_desc: Can be used to open Relic Chests in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
123002.item_bg_desc: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

140000.item_bg_desc: In this grand universe, moral standards are materialized into physical form. Thumbs-up approvals aren't a rare sight to behold.\nWhat matters is that you are recognized!

140004.item_bg_desc: An old coin from a time when metal was still a plentiful resource in Belobog.

item_comefrom.desc: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

140017.item_bg_desc: Defective parts collected from a malfunctioning robot.\n\n"You get what you pay for. Obviously, this is worthless."

140021.item_bg_desc: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"A pickaxe with a polished point might make for a decent weapon?"

140022.item_bg_desc: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"An ordinary respirator."

140023.item_bg_desc: According to Sampo, it's a piece of mining equipment that he lost.\n\n"Put it on and you'll be the finest in the mines."

140024.item_bg_desc: A strange ornament you found in the Corridor of Fading Echoes resembling a delicate drill.\n\n"'Balakin' is inscribed onto the back. Your intuition tells you this device isn't something simple..."

140025.item_bg_desc: An iron box passed down by the Balakin family, containing secrets left behind by their ancestors hundreds of years ago.\n\n"My ancestors left behind the iron box, but forgot to leave its key. Funny, very funny."

140026.item_bg_desc: An encryption key used to activate the energy core in the restricted zone.\n\n"Despite its apparent similarities to other cores, it is clear the energy core inside the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone is highly-customized."

140027.item_bg_desc: A custom key that can unlock the gear bridge inside the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone. Only officers are granted access permissions.

140032.item_bg_desc: A temporary pass allowing entry into the Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone.\n\n"Temporary workers in possession of this temporary pass may enter the restricted zone within three hours. Lending this pass to others is a felony, and offenders will suffer serious consequences."

140033.item_bg_desc: A part used to connect the body and chassis of a mine cart.\n\n"It is this small part that supports the entire structural integrity of the mine cart."

140034.item_bg_desc: Level-1 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

140035.item_bg_desc: Level-2 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

140036.item_bg_desc: Level-3 certification for opening the entrance of the Robot Settlement. Only those who have obtained all three certification levels can gain permission to open the door.\n\n"Hey, ow! Ow, ow, ow... Can't this robot be more gentle with a pretty girl's hand?"

140037.item_bg_desc: A Space Station Special Permit issued by Asta and Arlan. Allows you to freely enter and exit most cabins of the space station.\n\n"Why not all cabins you ask? Let's just say, researchers of Herta Space Station are all crouching tigers, I don't want to limit their imaginations when it comes to unlocking things."

140039.item_bg_desc: A part used for connecting mine cart wheels.\n\n"A sturdy axle connects two mine cart wheels."

140040.item_bg_desc: Proof of Julian's capacities.\n\n"There are no masters and newbies with marbles. Only those who grab the opportunities can win."

140041.item_bg_desc: Treasure across time.\n\n"I didn't dig out ninety percent of the time capsules."

140046.item_bg_desc: A key that can be used in the Rivet Town Commercial District.\n\n"The Fragmentum has come and everyone has fled. What Chamber of Commerce?"

140065.item_bg_desc: A big bear doll that has been stashed away.\n\n"Natasha's hand-made bear doll. Admittedly, it is rather cute."

140066.item_bg_desc: A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map that looks rather sketchy. Is it... accurate?"

140067.item_bg_desc: A map that supposedly leads to treasure.\n\n"A Treasure Map made a long time ago. Judging by how old it is, seems quite convincing."

140068.item_bg_desc: Chitin that looks like armor, taken from a Fragmentum Monster.\n\n"Who wants something like this..."

140069.item_bg_desc: A pamphlet about the used item auction.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."

140070.item_bg_desc: A navigation map with "recipient address" marked on it.\n\n"Heron Express would like to warn you about the latest scam, 'We left your delivery at your door.'"

140071.item_bg_desc: Intricate parts dotted around the Disposal Site. Hardly anyone would notice these dated-looking dull little things. Iron and nickel are gifts from the shooting star, but ultra nickel is something entirely different... Produced with mysterious methods, this superalloy, though outdated in the eyes of Herta, is patented and has no competition in the entire universe.\n\n"No competition? You get one of these for 10 credits on the black market. They say you can use it to repair all the beacons in the universe, very versatile."

140072.item_bg_desc: A signal log in which is recorded the affirmative answer from Lesley and the truth about the starquake. It is sweet yet cruel.\n\n"Knowing how Rocky is, even I can't predict what he might do when he learns the truth."

140073.item_bg_desc: A fake log with Lesley's answer. Whoever made this hopes to maintain the fragile balance of Rocky's life using abrupt rejection.\n\n"She will say no to him and his life will go on. It's always easier to forget than to heal."

140074.item_bg_desc: A clip of the footage captured by the Herta Panopticon System. With all researchers under constant watch, there's no keeping secrets.\n\n"Surveillance is the bane of secrets but also the best historian-to-be. You can trace back to the beginning of everything, be it good or bad."

140075.item_bg_desc: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"As if you have fallen into a space that has neither beginning nor end, you look through a standard-issue navigation visor and stare into the deepest retreat of the vast universe. In the distance, you see a dim blue dot, like a drop of water before the canvas of darkness."

140076.item_bg_desc: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"That's the most direct evidence of the power of the Aeons. The justice people are seeking seems almost amusing in the face of a doomed planet... The hollow and eerily fast utterance is proof that the last bit of the videotape has been corrupted by something."

140077.item_bg_desc: A videotape that recorded the intricate secrets of the space station. Its maker went the extra mile in making it secure by installing a most extraordinary security mechanism.\n\n"There are no reinforcements. If you can, please come back following the route we agreed on in advance. Do you copy? The intermittent sound from the cosmic radio is calling a name repeatedly. There is no reply."

140078.item_bg_desc: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: Dear kindhearted soul, can you buy me a stamp and post this for me? A thousand thanks!\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

140079.item_bg_desc: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To Carlo Eyre, Room B<unbreak>03</unbreak>, Building <unbreak>35</unbreak>, 6th Street, Administrative District.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

140080.item_bg_desc: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: To my one and only; my precious; my eternally youthful; my clever and witty; the one worthy of all my love to protect; the one who may not even exist: The true love of my future.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

140081.item_bg_desc: An envelope found in Belobog.\nThe envelope reads: The trash I wrote should never see the light of day. That's fine, it can rot forever in the bottom of the dark mailbox.\nMaybe someone in the Overworld can help you with this unsent letter.

140082.item_bg_desc: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Milk powder and a thermal baby bottle. Very thoughtful indeed..."

140083.item_bg_desc: Anonymous package not yet delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Next to the anonymous package lies its sender."

140084.item_bg_desc: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Thousand Stars."\n\n"Obviously this card was extremely valuable, but it was discarded like trash when someone lost interest... Sounds like something Herta would do."

140085.item_bg_desc: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "██." "When you run your fingers past the incomprehensible letters, you can't help but think: Maybe this card is one of those collector's edition things. Could it be that having all the cards can grant you the power to summon... that Aeon?"

140086.item_bg_desc: A mysterious card used to access an unknown facility. Its corner has been chipped away, and the letters on it have become unrecognizable. But when you hold it under the light at a certain angle, you can see the faint letters that read "Corporate."\n\n"Trust me, this is no doubt an access card used to open multiple layers of secured hatches, and it must have been developed by big corporations. The room it unlocks must also have been built by some pan-cosmic magnate."

140090.item_bg_desc: A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Rubbing alcohol — hope it hasn't evaporated too much..."

140091.item_bg_desc: A box of medical supplies urgently needed by Natasha.\n\n"Natasha's home-made painkillers. People faint just from the smell."

140095.item_bg_desc: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Children fall asleep to stories. A must-try for young parents..."

140096.item_bg_desc: One of the anonymous packages delivered to the clinic.\n\n"Soft and breathable, our quality clothing is designed to protect your baby from sweat. Perfect for silky-smooth skin."

140097.item_bg_desc: Old letters that Kluzer carries around.\n\n"He didn't have the time to post them... maybe he didn't need to anymore..."

140098.item_bg_desc: An old yellowing photo. Evidence of a certain individual's part in a certain historic event. The figure in the picture did not seem to plan to let people feel the historical weight this photo should carry. "What will become of Belobog in a hundred years? Well, you'll have to see it through your eyes."

140103.item_bg_desc: Commodity contract for the auction. Use it to get paid based on the value of the goods.\n\n"They always put 'Handle with Care' on the contract but everyone ignores it."

140104.item_bg_desc: Rare relic from ancient times. Can be used with intricate Old World instruments.\n\n"A way for vagrants to trade... an auction sounds like a good idea."

140105.item_bg_desc: Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

140106.item_bg_desc: Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

140107.item_bg_desc: Letter from outer space by Hosea Lazaro the comet hunter — full of rubbish.\n\n"Back when I was still in the space station, I would look into the night sky in search of those faraway celestial bodies. Those clouds of stars, soft and alluring, captured my anxious heart. If you are like me, it's only a matter of time before people crown you with the title 'comet hunter'."

140108.item_bg_desc: The Xenohydro was confined within a Mystic Case in the shape of a trapezohedron, with one of the planes made from the Absolutely Objective Lens. It is observed that the Xenohydro has icy blue skin that has silver spots dotted around. If you look through other planes to observe the Xenohydro, you'll find that it looks rather different. In fact, the image of the Xenohydro will vary from person to person.\n\n"I have a feeling that compared with the Xenohydro, this case is the actual curio. It can be worth quite a lot on the curio market."

140109.item_bg_desc: The uncrowned king of the beverage world, a coarse slice of manly friendship, and together with a lethal dosage of humor.\n\n"A big barrel of pure caramel, a few jumping peas here and there, a handful of fresh canterbury bells, and some interdimensional leaves. Don't forget a drop of Ambergris of Abundance and a few rolls of orchid zest. How much of a kick you want is your choice."

140111.item_bg_desc: A key with its teeth all worn smooth and not looking like it can open doors anytime soon.\n\n"Rivet Town Chamber of Commerce? Ask Julian if he knows about it."

140112.item_bg_desc: A treasure map decoded with a Special Autoradiograph, revealing hidden coordinates within the space station.\n\n"I heard that scoundrel left behind some good stuff in the space station. This must be where the treasure is."

140114.item_bg_desc: Bronya's toy as a child. The snowy owl circles above the snowfields, looking for the best opportunity to hunt the hare.\n\n"Even if our connection with the past is completely broken, there are still things that can complete us."

140115.item_bg_desc: A very expensive flower. It blooms only once a year for a month.\n\n"But honestly, the price is completely worth that one month of bloom!"

140116.item_bg_desc: An eight-petalled flower with white spots at each tip, just like snowflakes.\n\n"A long time ago, the initial snow of the year symbolized harvest and joy."

140117.item_bg_desc: An aristocratic flower beloved by high society.\n\n"Rumor has it that a noblewoman spent her entire family's fortune on one of these flowers. This was why it was given the name Marquise."

140118.item_bg_desc: A lovely small red-and-yellow flower that looks like the sun.\n\n"Just looking at it makes you feel warm inside."

140119.item_bg_desc: Common mechanical parts used everywhere.\n\n"The prospectors say this is the specialty of corners and gaps. It kinda makes sense..."

140120.item_bg_desc: A metal casing removed from discarded robots. Maybe it can still be used.\n\n"It's common for animals to molt, but have you seen robots molt?"

140121.item_bg_desc: A cold metallic construct, but a burning passion perhaps hides beneath the petals.\n\n"It is cold to the touch, but warm if you put it against your body. Where on your body? Try your heart."

140123.item_bg_desc: Portable backup power source for the elevator. Can be used in an emergency after being assembled.\n\n"Safety and portability are both great, but the capacity... who designed this!?"

140124.item_bg_desc: A token required to cross an important location.

140125.item_bg_desc: This seems to be a note that Mei had dropped. Messy writing fills the page with records on how to look after some common flower species.

140126.item_bg_desc: This seems to be a note that Mei had dropped. Messy writing fills the page with records of what she had learned from other housekeepers.

140127.item_bg_desc: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the victim's jumbled statements.

140128.item_bg_desc: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the witness' jumbled statements.

140129.item_name: Testimony From the Suddenly Excited Man
140129.item_bg_desc: Testimony that Tantan had recorded at the scene of the incident. It is no simple task to get useful information out of the witness' jumbled statements.

140130.item_bg_desc: A picture of the lane taken by the cycrane. Starskiffs fly to and fro within the lane. The offending starskiff tried to hide within the traffic, only to expose itself.

140132.item_bg_desc: Handwritten cards with words of encouragement from Capote to his fans.\n\n"Master Capote's care and love for everyone is contained in these words!"

140133.item_bg_desc: A photo snapped from a unique angle and contains Capote's autograph.\n\n"Master Capote authorized it! It's not an intrusion of privacy!"

140134.item_bg_desc: The wiki-style encyclopedia that Capote's fans created themselves. Its contents mostly involve Capote's sayings.\n\n"Master Capote's keyword in life has been updated. The most recent version is: Illumination!"

140135.item_bg_desc: A personal special pass belonging to Arlan, with Peppy's photo stuck to it.\n\n"Brother is certainly loyal, and he carries his good friend's photo whenever he goes."

140136.item_bg_desc: An alloy ceiling tile that is heavily damaged after a strong impact.\n\n"Will us Security Department have to... pay the bill for repairs?"

140137.item_bg_desc: Arlan used too much force during combat and left a footprint on the floor tile.\n\n"We Security Department should use this as our insignia next year!"

140138.item_bg_desc: A photo of Arlan's back as he heads to the suspicious crystal on his own to investigate. The determination in his steps is obvious.\n\n"Brother is definitely a bear amongst horses! His figure is so cool!"

140139.item_name: Dirty Ribbon Tied to a Bell
140139.item_bg_desc: A white ribbon stained beyond recognition by an unknown filth. A bell is pinned to the end of the delicate woven fabric, its chime guiding the blind girl through the darkness. "That familiar, crisp chime... Big Sis, are you back..."

140140.item_bg_desc: A small, handcrafted music box. Though kept under good care for many years, it has fallen into a state of disrepair. The melody produced by the wooden box was somewhat unsettling, nonetheless, it was cherished by the two girls, who relied on each other like sisters. "Welcome... home..."

140141.item_bg_desc: A black envelope. A pitiful pin hangs on the spot where there should have been a fire lacquer seal. On the back is writing in large, crooked letters: "Invitation." \n\n"I see you're a chosen one..."

140146.item_bg_desc: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. Peak is its intended recipient.

140147.item_bg_desc: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. The rapper Eunice is its intended recipient.

140148.item_bg_desc: A package not delivered by Wildfire in time. Its intended recipient could be one of the patients in the clinic.

140149.item_bg_desc: Gaily wrapped gift. From the appearance, it can be seen that a lot of thought was spent on packaging this gift. \n\n"Giving disposable cutlery as a gift... You're implying that the recipient doesn't like to wash dishes."

140150.item_bg_desc: A watch that was almost mistaken for a bomb. It was said that a person's prized accessories can reflect their taste to an extent.\n\n"So I offered up three mansions in exchange for his watch..."

140151.item_bg_desc: A bouquet of fresh Ball Peony blossoms. In floriography, it means "patience."

140152.item_bg_desc: A bunch of tiny Rainbow blossoms. In floriography, it means "the beauty of the ordinary."

140153.item_bg_desc: A bouquet of fresh First Snow blossoms. In floriography, it means "purity and kindness."

140154.item_bg_desc: A stalk of exquisite Marquise blossoms. It represents a status of prestige.

140155.item_bg_desc: A letter from the Restricted Zone Logistics Officer Gilbert to his daughter Lila in the Overworld.

140156.item_bg_desc: A badge representing justice. It might shed some light on this Disciple of Sanctus Medicus' social identity. If you flaunt it carelessly, you'll only invite unwanted ridicule to yourself.

140157.item_bg_desc: A letter between the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. The correct words will only appear in the hands of the intended recipient.

140158.item_bg_desc: A family photo taken somewhere not on the Xianzhou Luofu. Evidently, this Disciple of Sanctus Medicus came from a different world. He came here either chasing the distant idea of immortality or to cure a disease. He has a bright smile in the photo, drastically different to how he looked when you met him on the street.\n\n"We'll take another family photo together on the seaside rocks when you're back..."

140159.item_bg_desc: A medical prescription. The messy writing makes one question the sanity of the author.\n\n"5 mace of Daiyu angelica, 3 mace of Tian Dong, mixed into the... of Xianzhou natives who have reached 600 years of age."

140161.item_bg_desc: A standard package for delivery. It is tightly sealed and heading towards its recipient.

140162.item_bg_desc: A polearm that was sliced in half. One can imagine the fate that befell its master.

140163.item_bg_desc: A token required to traverse across an important location. Looks like the process of acquiring this token was not very smooth.

140164.item_bg_desc: A grenade with its pin pulled. It is silent, as though it might start growling at any moment.\n\n"A little gift for the lost..."

140165.item_bg_desc: A chip for regulating language mastery, especially for standard-issue Belobogian Automaton.

140166.item_bg_desc: A piece of paper casually folded into a flower. The petals are delicate and life-like, and one wonders what kind of person would have bestowed such likenesses onto the paper.

140167.item_bg_desc: This seems to be a page torn from a Department of Insight researcher's notebook. It is full of obscure and difficult symbols and sentences. There are cute cat stickers on the back of the page — the owner was probably a cat lover.\n\n"For Department of Insight internal use only. Do not leak out this document."

140168.item_name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — Table of Contents
140168.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140169.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140170.item_name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Unexpected Parchment"
140170.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140171.item_name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Missing Miner's Lamp"
140171.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140172.item_name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "The Crates Are the Keys"
140172.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140173.item_name: The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure — "Treasure Hunt on the Battlefield"
140173.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140174.item_bg_desc: A few pages from a children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.\n\n"The Moles, the Moles, are brilliant and strong! The Moles, the Moles, take the reins!"

140175.item_bg_desc: An invitation for joining the Interastral Peace Corporation as a designer. Enthusiastic, cordial, with an astonishing salary offer.\n\n"Congratulations, Designer Ryan. We warmly invite you to join the IPC Technology Department."

140176.item_bg_desc: Standard parts set from the Artisanship Commission used to assemble different aurumatons.\n\n"I've told you a hundred times before that we want to industrialize. In. Dus. Tri. Al. Ize!"

140177.item_bg_desc: This boat Chengjie folded out of paper is like a tiny starskiff. Meticulously made and cute.\n\n"Master, I've finally graduated!"

140178.item_bg_desc: A fist-sized geomarrow crystal, reflecting an indigo luster.\nThat supervisor Antonia probably knows how much it's worth.

140179.item_bg_desc: A thermal mining pickaxe for Underworld miners. Often on-sold.\n<unbreak>80%</unbreak> new.

140180.item_bg_desc: A thermal mining pickaxe for Underworld miners. Often on-sold.\n<unbreak>60%</unbreak> new.

140181.item_bg_desc: Only the extremely lucky can get their hands on this crystal.\nIt doesn't look like it has any practical value, but it could be sold for a very good price.

140182.item_bg_desc: A small part used for mechanical production. Smaller than a person's fist.\n"It is this small part that supports an avenger's moral cleanliness."

140183.item_bg_desc: A rather artsy tin box sitting there silently like a book.\n"Please put this tin box on sale on the shelf on the second row to the right of Spare Time Book Shop's door..."

140184.item_bg_desc: Mineral deposit formed by some kind of creature. Rumored to be pearls that solidified from drakons' tears, and is very popular among Outworlders who love such legends.\n"Drakons in the ancient sea, centuries long they may live. Tears shed dry into pearls, fat burns in lamps of old."

140185.item_bg_desc: A Xianzhou-style scroll, on which Thousand-Handed Merciful Medicus' Salvation is written 500 times. Closer inspection reveals the last few hundred handwritings to be different from the first few hundred ones. Let's hope this doesn't get discovered.

140186.item_bg_desc: An unsent letter addressed home. The author seems to have undergone some experimental "treatment."

140187.item_bg_desc: A small nuclear weapon. Its countdown will begin automatically when it no longer detects the registrant's vital signs — In other words, you can't just throw it away.\n\n"Maybe we can chuck it in a lake somewhere..."

140188.item_bg_desc: An access code provided by a weird person. Go to Starskiff Haven and give it to Ziqiao. Maybe you'll get a pleasant surprise.

140189.item_bg_desc: A silly teacher forgot to wear clothes when he left in the morning. Go give him these clothes.

140190.item_bg_desc: Everyone has a beating heart. Emotions are often more effective than logic when persuading someone.

140191.item_name: Research Records "Pretend to Be an Officer"
140191.item_bg_desc: The Realm-Keeping Commission require their officers to be upright, kind, just, industrious, and empathetic. Not many people in reality can tick all those boxes.

140192.item_bg_desc: Ever seen a fist this big? It's all yours~

140193.item_bg_desc: Any problem you can solve with money isn't a problem. It's a shame money isn't omnipotent.

140194.item_bg_desc: Even those most skilled in lies and flattery often cannot resist the power of "sincerity."

140195.item_bg_desc: March 7th brandishes this imaginary title page and decisively declares, "The passphrase is maybe — probably — definitely written on it!"

140196.item_name: Pharmacological Studies on the Draught of Draconic Surge
140196.item_bg_desc: A research report on the Draught of Draconic Surge written by Dan Shu, the Alchemy Commission's genius chief alchemist. Hurry and pass this to the Seat of Divine Foresight.

140197.item_name: A Medicine Concocted by Dan Shu
140197.item_bg_desc: A medicine Dan Shu concocted for a young patient. Its sweet smell is probably deliberate, made to entice the child to take their medicine properly.

140198.item_bg_desc: Dan Shu said this medicine can invigorate the body and prolong one's life. She's the Alchemy Commission's chief alchemist and your close associate — You should be able to trust her and ingest this without issue.

140199.item_bg_desc: The jade abacus accessory that Yanqing left behind while carrying out an operation. It records his activities, and was dropped at a timely moment to warn the Seat of Divine Foresight.

140200.item_bg_desc: Messy writing that only a doctor can read.\n\n"This prescription can save people, but those who take it will hiccup uncontrollably every single day!"

140201.item_bg_desc: A package containing the gift for Banxia, wrapped in fabric and tied up with twine.\n\n"I know she's busy... I wanted to give this to her personally, but now I have to ask you to deliver it to her."

140202.item_bg_desc: A row of ready-to-eat raw frostweave salmon slices. The meat is firm and smooth and looks very tasty.\n\n"It's all thanks to the Eternal Freeze. We can eat raw fish from 700 years ago!"

140203.item_bg_desc: A mimic snow slug, one of the components of the local biome out on the Belobog Snow Plains. They can change their appearance to match the external environment and disguise themselves from their natural enemies. "These slugs taste really good once they've been barbecued over a fire..."

140206.item_bg_desc: A universal component in Belobog used to activate Geomarrow conduits.\n\n"Bro, you need to ask the real smart people. No one knows how to fix a machine better than Marev."

140207.item_bg_desc: A cold platter made from air-fried preserved frostweave salmon and bread, with a bowl of redsunset jam for free. Nowadays, frostweave salmon are mostly bred inside Belobog's walls. Their taste is miles off from the frostweave salmons fished from the wilds outside the city. "I heard having raw fish slices together with bread can delay the onset of diarrhea effectively. Is that true?" "Heck if I know. Go ask Natasha."

140208.item_bg_desc: The steel skewer has all sorts of Belobog delicacies on it, and is barbecued thoroughly using high heat. Its ingredients are mostly harmless. It is also the favorite food of Belobog's adventurers out in the wild, as well as being the most easily obtainable. "This tastes so good! What kinds of meat are in it, though?" "You wouldn't want to know."

140209.item_bg_desc: The iron bucket contains all sorts of Belobog delicacies as a stew, and is simmered thoroughly using low heat. Ingredients with outlandish appearances float in the soup, but it smells very delicious. "What's wrong if they were once specimens? Aren't they dead animals and plants anyways?"

140210.item_name: Floppy disk with a picture of Pela and her mother
140210.item_bg_desc: A digital data storage component that has been frozen for more than a decade. It looks very primitive. A young girl is being held by someone in the picture, but that someone's face is no longer distinguishable. "Did you hear about that outstanding outdoors explorer who died 16 years ago? The best explorer out of all Belobog..."

140211.item_bg_desc: A meteor fragment that bore witness to Belobog's <unbreak>700</unbreak> years of decline. It should be returned to the History and Culture Museum.

140212.item_bg_desc: A lost roll of film. It should be returned to the History and Culture Museum.

140213.item_bg_desc: Parts of the modern sculpture Gears and Wisdom that has been disassembled into countless tiny pieces. These parts have evidently been modified artistically and will not run as a machine.

140215.item_bg_desc: An old photo revealing the location of the exhibit "Mechanism Energy Hub."

140216.item_bg_desc: A treasure map revealing the location of the exhibit "Cannon."

140218.item_name: Treasure Map: Information Terminal and Display Monitor Set
140218.item_bg_desc: A treasure map revealing the location of the exhibit "Information Terminal and Display Monitor Set."

140219.item_bg_desc: Qingni remembered how affectionate her mother was, but she also remembered how stubborn and unreasonable her mother was when it came to "becoming a pilot."

140220.item_bg_desc: At the end of the Third Denizens of Abundance War, Reignbow Arbiter's Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow wiped out everything along the way. The Xianzhou people used the burning embers of the arrow to create many divine objects, and this is one of them. Yukong carries it with her, lest she forgets.\n\n"We were so happy then. I wish we could stay in those moments forever."

140221.item_bg_desc: Jing Yuan still clearly remembers those two young pilots. They were optimistic, brave, and talented. But, he also remembers how it all ended.

140222.item_bg_desc: Yukong hopes to still be that carefree foxian girl, flying through the skies. But time will always pass by turbulently.

140223.item_bg_desc: Caiyi hopes that her friend can take care of her daughter, and let her daughter be anything the child wants to be... Except a fighter pilot.

140225.item_bg_desc: A Xianzhou medical compendium compiled by the Alchemy Commission. It includes prescriptions to many decoctions and have been listed in the Required Reading for New Recruits to the Alchemy Commission list.\n\n"Memorize these, you will be tested on them."

140228.item_bg_desc: A branch that exudes an eerie aura, it is a rare ingredient in some prescriptions.\n\n"Does this... really have medicinal use?"

140229.item_bg_desc: A lost and found notice for a missing ingenium.\n\n"I'm unsure of the exact time, but I lost a Baroumbrella ingenium that can write poetry near Synwood Pavilion in the Exalting Sanctum..."

140230.item_bg_desc: A collection of poems left by a Vidyadhara poet from the Xianzhou Luofu that contains 523 untitled poems, and the themes are almost all about extremely mundane things.\n\n"To those who love poetry: Whoever does not talk about this collection is shallow and ignorant."

140231.item_bg_desc: A Jade Abacus that stores machine learning data and codes. It is used to help Cong write poems.\n\n"They say 'Poetry cannot be about technology, as it is not romantic,' but technology can be romantic, right?"

140232.item_bg_desc: When Cong emerged from his hatching rebirth, he carried this Unity Lock with him.\n\n"If those who love each other are bound by the Unity Lock, they will be united forever."

140233.item_bg_desc: In the middle of the reward plaque is written "Genius Diviner."\n\n"Your talent and knowledge are as solid as stainless steel."

140234.item_bg_desc: A new generation flagship jade abacus, its off-white material feels exquisite to the touch.\n\n"Never buy an old jade abacus — they put out new models all the time."

140235.item_name: Cloudbreadth Sleeves Limited Vertical Collar Jacket
140235.item_bg_desc: The Nimbus Chronicles series women's cropped jacket with a stand-up collar launched by Cloudbreadth Sleeves is tailored using mid-length-fiber nylon-wool mixed fabric and pure silk.\n\n"The Cloudbreadth Sleeves clothes are delicate, ethereal, and expensive!"

140237.item_bg_desc: The computer module that Zhongshan handed to you. Adding it to those damaged automatons seems to be able to "resurrect them from the dead." Somehow, this module also has a solar panel attached to it.

140239.item_bg_desc: The torn manuscript contains faintly discernible notes on conjectures related to "Sensor No. <unbreak>223</unbreak>" and the "big universe time tunnel" theory.

140240.item_bg_desc: A slightly rusty key with no clear indication of which lock it corresponds to. Try it on all the locks you can until you find the right one!

140241.item_bg_desc: The torn manuscript contains faintly discernible notes on conjectures related to "Sensor No. <unbreak>223</unbreak>" and the "big universe time tunnel" theory.

140242.item_name: A tuskpir wrap bought for Bailu
140242.item_bg_desc: A cake roll that is too cute to eat. It gets its name from the beautiful patterns on the roll that resembles a tuskpir's fur. "This cake roll is so cute and looks like a tuskpir!" "It's actually made of tuskpirs." "???"

140243.item_name: A songlotus cake bought for Bailu
140243.item_bg_desc: A classic snack made from songlotus on the Luofu. Once you take a bite, it makes a crisp laughing sound. Occasionally, Luofu's gormandizers use it to tease outworlders. "You scared the life out of me!"

140244.item_bg_desc: Berrypheasants live in symbiosis with plants, with many fruit hanging from their tail. Berrypheasant Skewers are actually fruit skewers. No Berrypheasants were harmed during the production process. "So... is this a meat dish or a vegetarian dish?"

140245.item_name: Steamed puffergoat milk bought for Bailu
140245.item_bg_desc: Puffergoat milk, also known as Gentle Halcyon milk, is a specialty of the Xianzhou Alliance. The milk is difficult to preserve and rarely seen outside Xianzhou. It is sweet after warming without needing extra sugar, but it becomes bitter after cooling, so it must be drunk while hot. "According to the Lifitide magazine, General Jing Yuan has to drink a large bowl of freshly-squeezed Puffergoat milk every morning. The Seat of Divine Foresight has denied this report."

140246.item_name: Mung bean soda bought for Bailu
140246.item_bg_desc: Made from fermented legume-based products. It smells sour and pungent, but tastes cool and refreshing. If you can drink a big bottle of mung bean soda and remain calm, you will definitely impress the gormandizers on the Luofu. "Like mung beans? Like soda? Then what are you complaining about!?"

140247.item_bg_desc: A box containing the Golden Cloud Toad. The name and contact information of the sender were deliberately crossed out, but records from Heron Express show that the sender is A-Feng.

140248.item_bg_desc: Dock Worker A-Feng's payment record. The record shows recently received credit remitted by the Interastral Peace Corporation, spaced out over several installments.

140249.item_bg_desc: The testimony of dock worker A-Feng, who has admitted to disrupting the normal operations of the dock in exchange for payment from the IPC.

140250.item_bg_desc: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

140251.item_bg_desc: This contract can prove that the Merchant Guild has legitimate rights to operate the dock.

140252.item_bg_desc: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

140253.item_bg_desc: Since Artistry Hardware partnered with the dock, its scope of operations has expanded, and its revenue and customer satisfaction have both increased.

140254.item_bg_desc: It is evident that at its peak, the old Aurum Alley had a trading volume similar to what the Alley has today.

140255.item_name: Aurum Alley Merchant Guild Bidding Deposit
140255.item_bg_desc: The most tangible achievement of the Aurum Alley revival project. It demonstrates that the Alley still has plenty of life in it.

140256.item_bg_desc: The Special Combo Set that Spices Supreme has produced serves to prove that the Alley is still a strong contender, and is highly competitive as a food street.

140257.item_bg_desc: Surveys conducted to gauge the shop owners' intentions. More and more shops have voiced their support for the guild and expressed their confidence in the revival project.

140258.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140259.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140260.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140261.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140262.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140263.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140264.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140265.item_bg_desc: A rubbing put together at a particular angle, portraying the secret insignia left by Scholar Bernini, who was Todd's teacher. It seems to be hiding some important information.

140266.item_bg_desc: A scene you photographed. It seems to be that of a father and son parting.\n\n"I'm going to buy some oranges for you. Stay here and don't wander off, okay?"

140267.item_bg_desc: A scene you photographed. It seems to be that of lovers parting.\n\n"Chonghua, I love you. 'Till mara do us part."

140268.item_bg_desc: A scene you photographed. It seems to be that of friends parting.\n\n"I'm afraid we might never see each other again after this goodbye."

140269.item_bg_desc: A Jade Abacus that stores machine learning data and codes. It is used to help Cong write poems.\n\n"They say 'Poetry cannot be about technology, as it is not romantic,' but technology can be romantic, right?"

140270.item_bg_desc: A Jade Abacus that stores machine learning data and codes. It is used to help Cong write poems.\n\n"They say 'Poetry cannot be about technology, as it is not romantic,' but technology can be romantic, right?"

140271.item_bg_desc: A special stone slate left by the Vidyadhara. There seems to be information about certain "sequences" hidden in its mottled markings.\n\n"Follow the lights, as the stone describes."

140272.item_bg_desc: Todd always carries his notebook with him to record his profound thoughts and research on different topics.

140273.item_bg_desc: The fan Tingyun carried on her person. It used to be a pair, but one had gone missing.

140274.item_bg_desc: The minuscule jade stamp worn by Amicassadors of the Sky-Faring Commission.

140275.item_name: Small Chest Sent to the Sleepless Earl
140275.item_bg_desc: A small chest that stores plant seeds. The crest for the Sleepless Earl is stamped onto the lid.

140276.item_name: Kitchen Knife Sent to Spices Supreme
140276.item_bg_desc: A sharp kitchen knife wrapped in soft silk. It also contains an advertisement hiring workers for Spices Supreme.

140277.item_name: An Archery Set Gifted For Someone Unknown
140277.item_bg_desc: An archery set with supreme balance. Surprisingly, it seems to have been completely hand-crafted. No Xianzhou technology was used to create it, and the arrow can't track enemies or automatically make turns.

140278.item_desc: Upon use, immediately heals one target ally by <unbreak>36%</unbreak> of the ally's Max HP plus <unbreak>460</unbreak> extra HP.
140278.item_bg_desc: A new tea variety brewed using the improved Whale-Tide Spring, Emerald Hills, and Dawndew strains. It has a sweet, long-lasting taste, twirling about inside your mouth like clouds.

140279.item_desc: When used, instantly recovers 4 Technique Points for the team.
140279.item_bg_desc: A bowl of fresh, fragrant, boiling, and spicy beef offal stew. It's made with yellow boulder beef chunks and offal together with redcloud chili sauce.

140280.item_bg_desc: A paper kite commemorating the pilot who can no longer fly.

140281.item_bg_desc: One half of the jade abacus of allying oath gifted to you by Jing Yuan. Hold on to the jade abacus and send out information, and the other half will immediately receive it. No matter the distance, the Luofu Cloud Knights will surely arrive at your side and carry out your request.

140282.item_bg_desc: A treasure map guiding players to find the encryption key for the elevator in Herta Space Station's Victory Zone. The map depicts a Wubbaboo hiding inside a room. Finding it might grant access to the elevator encryption key.

140283.item_bg_desc: A treasure map guiding players to find the Championship Contender Pass in Herta Space Station's Victory Zone. The map depicts a Wubbaboo hiding in... a toilet? Finding it might grant access to the Championship Contender Pass, but the correct toilet needs to be found first.

140284.item_bg_desc: A treasure map guiding players to find the Championship Contender Pass in Herta Space Station's Victory Zone. The map depicts a Wubbaboo surrounded by paper cranes. Finding it might grant access to the Championship Contender Pass. Try to collect all the paper cranes.

140285.item_bg_desc: A treasure map guiding players to find the Championship Contender Pass in Herta Space Station's Victory Zone. The map depicts a Wubbaboo hiding in a Curio Cabinet. Finding it might grant access to the Championship Contender Pass. The Curios depicted on the treasure map are Crackup Conch, Joy Filtration Set, Unbearable Weight, and Total Eclipse of the Heart, in that order. Try to arrange these Curios according to the map.

140286.item_bg_desc: A necessary item to play Aetherium Wars. Can store creatures in the form of an Aether — and then manifest them as Aether Spirits to battle against other players.\n\n"Collect, battle, train, and upgrade!"

140287.item_bg_desc: An encryption key hidden by Wubbaboo that activates the elevator in Herta Space Station's Victory Zone. Elevator encryption key specially designed by Herta Space Station for usage in the Aetherium Wars.

140288.item_bg_desc: One of three passes required to challenge the championship contender in the Victory Zone of Herta Space Station. With Herta's reluctant consent, the Aetherium Wars Tournament Association revamped the space station and set up obstacles for the players.

140289.item_bg_desc: One of three passes required to challenge the championship contender in the Victory Zone of Herta Space Station. With Herta's reluctant consent, the Aetherium Wars Tournament Association revamped the space station and set up obstacles for the players.

140290.item_bg_desc: One of three passes required to challenge the championship contender in the Victory Zone of Herta Space Station. With Herta's reluctant consent, the Aetherium Wars Tournament Association revamped the space station and set up obstacles for the players.

140291.item_bg_desc: The miracle medicine Mr. Xiyan made up in the story. He claims these medicines have parallels in real life, but you're not silly enough to believe in that.\n\n"What {NICKNAME} beholds is a lotus blooming with ice crystals while in flames... This is a medicine that has been extinct since the Theophany Era! The Icefire Lotus!"

140292.item_bg_desc: The miracle medicine Mr. Xiyan made up in the story. He claims these medicines have parallels in real life, but you're not silly enough to believe in that.\n\n"What the warrior beholds is a mushroom that seems to waft in and out of existence. This is no mere mushroom. It sits within a state between existence and non-existence, constantly fluctuating between the real and the imaginary... It's called the 'Life-Death Polypore'."

140293.item_bg_desc: The miracle medicine Mr. Xiyan made up in the story. He claims these medicines have parallels in real life, but you're not silly enough to believe in that.\n\n"There is no wind, yet the aerial roots wave in the wind. The air is cleaved apart and lightning sparks following the curvature of their movements. That is the most precious medicine in all the Alchemy Commission — the Whirlbolt Pneumatophore!"

140294.item_bg_desc: The miracle medicine Mr. Xiyan made up in the story. He claims it can make people "be born anew and achieve transcendence," but the name sounds pretty dodgy.\n\n"Listen, this isn't some half-baked 'cure-all quackery'. All it does is help you 'ascend to the heavens,' which is not that far-fetched, plotwise."

140295.item_bg_desc: A high-tech medicine used to nurture starskiff seeds in Mr. Xiyan's story. This thing may exist in reality — just not with the exaggerated effects. "You might not be aware that the seeds used by the Xianzhou to grow starskiffs are of the same origin as the Arbor. Using such wood to make sword hilts won't be the same as using wood straight off the Arbor, but it's more than enough to defeat one mere Lord Ravager." "Seriously?" "Who cares. Just say the lines!"

140296.item_name: Treasure Map Indicating the Location of Ignis Aureliae
140296.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is a treasure map recording the location of the Ignis Aureliae. But in your eyes, this is just an Alchemy Commission map with a random circle drawn on it. "It is said that 'A Sword Is Mightier When Hidden.' He therefore hid the Ignis Aureliae away from potential thieves before he was incarcerated." "There it is! The classic adventure story trope where a century-old treasure map just gets discovered out of nowhere!"

140297.item_bg_desc: A snack that Todd wants to eat. It may be childish for a child, but is just right for an adult.

140298.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is wood from the Arbor, ready to be made into a weapon hilt. But in your eyes, this is just a tree branch. "The seed in the vessel gradually sprouts and countless twigs converge into one, as if an invisible hand is weaving it into the shape of a hilt." "Say what you want. This is still just a tree branch."

140299.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the metal required to forge divine weapons. But in your eyes, this is probably something Mr. Xiyan dug out of a trashcan. "This looks like someone barbecued it. Is it really safe?" "It's special effects. I added special effects."

140300.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the weapon you and {TEXTJOIN#59} managed to forge. You can tell at a glance that this {TEXTJOIN#61}, glowing with iridescent and otherworldly light, is no ordinary item.\nIn actuality, it is fitted with some LEDs in there. They light up if you press the switch. (Hold down the switch and the weapon will play a sound that says "Villain! Prepare to die!".)

140301.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the weapon you and {TEXTJOIN#59} managed to forge. You can tell at a glance that this {TEXTJOIN#61}, emitting an aura of pure danger, is no ordinary item.\nIt's actually a toy laser gun belonging to Mr. Xiyan's little niece. He forcibly got the toy off her to use it as a prop, and she didn't talk to him for three days. (He returned the toy laser gun to her later and apologized sincerely.)

140302.item_bg_desc: Mr. Xiyan shoves a jewelry box into your hands. The box is full of fake emerald pendants made from green beer bottle glass and fake diamond rings made of glass marbles. He says this is the high elders' secret treasure. You say there's no way that's the case. He says he's the scriptwriter, not you. You decide to get him back later.\n\n"Never mind... just perform it like it's a mime without prop..."

140303.item_bg_desc: The storytelling collection that Mr. Xiyan had written based on your adventures. The title page contains "Based On A True Story" in big letters, but most of the content is made up. The process of making up this story was pure chaos, but honestly the final story was not half bad. Artistic creation is a wonder indeed.\n\n"The Trailblazer's legend continues!"

140304.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the weapon you and {TEXTJOIN#59} managed to forge. You can tell at a glance that this dark and faded {TEXTJOIN#61} has a legendary past.\nOriginally there were LEDs in there. They light up if you press the switch and looked really fancy. Then the batteries went flat and Mr. Xiyan hasn't gotten around to change them yet.

140305.item_bg_desc: In Mr. Xiyan's story, this is the weapon you and {TEXTJOIN#59} managed to forge. You can tell at a glance that this dark and faded {TEXTJOIN#61} has a legendary past.\nIt's actually a toy laser gun belonging to Mr. Xiyan's little niece. Then he ran its batteries flat, and she didn't talk to him for three days. (He returned the toy laser gun to her after replacing the batteries. They have now reconciled.)

140306.item_bg_desc: Notes compiled by Little Tian. However, the perplexing rare illnesses within the cosmos have long exceeded her scope of expertise.

140307.item_bg_desc: Proof that Little Tian also plays Celestial Jade. One can imagine how Qingque and Little Tian became acquainted.

140308.item_bg_desc: Healer's note previously presented by Qingque. Later on, the Alchemy Commission dispatched specialists to verify the fictional ailments.

140309.item_name: Collaboration Invitation from the Interastral Peace Corporation
140309.item_bg_desc: The IPC has sent invites to all guild merchants in Aurum Alley wishing to strike deals with all of them.

140310.item_bg_desc: Storytellers spin up tales all the time about heroes and heroines and legions and knights. Yet this tale goes beyond a storyteller's imagination — it draws inspiration from your extraordinary adventures.\n\nTo find out what happens next, please tune in next time.

140311.item_bg_desc: The Light Cone gifted by the Garden of Recollection to March 7th. The memory sealed within is none other than her "origin." "An eagle borne on mighty wings will never miss the cliffs it once fell from, and a full-mast ship will never miss the beach where she once ran aground. And you, my child, know that the past is as intangible as a hazy mirage. But everything you are experiencing right now will surely be etched in stone by those who come after."

140312.item_bg_desc: An item obtained from the Abundance Sprite: Wooden Lupus. It is not a natural creation, and its edibility is unknown.\n\n"Seriously? They're trying to unshackle this thing? Are they just trying to 'unshackle' themselves from life?"

140313.item_bg_desc: Confidential documents from the Seat of Divine Foresight. It records the entire process of Yongren joining the Cloud Knights.\n\n"Codename: 27-149"

140314.item_bg_desc: Recordings of Mr. Xiyan's storytelling, can be played repeatedly.\n\n"Last time, we were talking about..."

140315.item_name: Authorized Recordings by Back'n and Forth
140315.item_bg_desc: Recordings of Back'n and Forth's crosstalk routine. Can be played repeatedly. "I will be presenting a crosstalk segment today..." "Since you can do it yourself, what am I here for."

140316.item_bg_desc: The "goods" that Mr. Huo entrusted you to transport, the box is tightly wrapped, and you can't see what's inside.\n\n"Top secret! Looking's for free, but don't touch!"

140317.item_bg_desc: A forbidden text readable only by the illiterate, for when those of literary awareness lay gaze upon its pages, they run the risk of being stripped clean of all knowledge. "Alright. Got it all in your head yet?" "My head's empty. I've forgotten everything."

140318.item_bg_desc: A book readable only by the blind. It is said that reading this text will grant one a special kind of awareness and alter their perception of the world.\n\n"It's not like a sound echoing within your mind, but the actual presence of someone by your side."

140319.item_bg_desc: A text that can drive one mad if even glanced upon. Not every victim experiences the same kind of insanity, but most types of madness remained extremely dangerous.\n\n"Don'treaditdon'treaditdon'treadit."

140320.item_bg_desc: "We've been through a huge crisis and are still recovering... but there are some who are trying to exploit the chaos to agitate the workforce."\n"People are growing more and more distrustful of the management here. It's probably turned into a big headache for Asta too."

140321.item_bg_desc: "Some researchers have been questioning the management and security of the space station ever since the invasion."\n"Things had settled down a bit with the reconstruction efforts, but the researchers' disappearances has rattled them again."

140322.item_bg_desc: "A Curio without a body but is alive... I've heard of such a species."\n"A colleague who came back from a business trip said that the Xianzhou Alliance has lifeforms like that."

140323.item_bg_desc: "I heard something like that also exists in the Xianzhou Alliance."\n"Ah, that's right. They're called heliobi. I guess you could say that wubbaboos and heliobi are sort of like cousins — both are types of energy lifeforms."

140324.item_bg_desc: "That means every victim's disappearance was accompanied by incomprehensible fires."\n"When we made visits to the scenes, some witness testimonies proved that too..."\n"The words they used were... 'Spontaneous combustion of the human body.'"

140325.item_bg_desc: "Let me describe it again in case you forgot: It's an energy lifeform. It doesn't have a body, but it is alive."\n"An energy lifeform?"\n"That's not the point. I wouldn't be bothering with it if it didn't have something to do with the Genius Society."

140326.item_bg_desc: Arlan compiled a list of victims during the investigation of the spontaneous human body combustion incidents. On the surface, these people have nothing in common with each other, but perceptive ones like Pamela still found subtle connections between them.

140327.item_bg_desc: Wen Shiling said Adler kept muttering the word "phrase" before he disappeared. Is it possible that it was some other word with a similar pronunciation?

140328.item_bg_desc: The booklet Adler was reading up to his disappearance. It records the lives of a few Genius Society members — The content consists of quite a few pieces of interesting information.

140329.item_bg_desc: According to Dan Heng's speculation, Ifrit's flame may have abilities other than just burning. Moreover, there happens to be a kind of fire that can phase through dimensions and possesses similar properties — "Burns through worlds, leaving numerous scions of flame behind."

140330.item_bg_desc: "We've been through a huge crisis and are still recovering... but there are some who are trying to exploit the chaos to agitate the workforce."\n"People are growing more and more distrustful of the management here. It's probably turned into a big headache for Asta too."

140331.item_bg_desc: A letter of unknown origin. Its penmanship is like swordplay, strokes unrestrained.

140334.item_bg_desc: "That means every victim's disappearance was accompanied by incomprehensible fires."\n"When we made visits to the scenes, some witness testimonies proved that too..."\n"The words they used were... 'Spontaneous combustion of the human body.'"

140335.item_bg_desc: "Let me describe it again in case you forgot: It's an energy lifeform. It doesn't have a body, but it is alive."\n"An energy lifeform?"\n"That's not the point. I wouldn't be bothering with it if it didn't have something to do with the Genius Society."

140336.item_bg_desc: The timeline of the Trailblazer's own actions around the period Herta was attacked. This was reconstructed by the Trailblazer via sorting out their memories.

140339.item_bg_desc: While you are experiencing this Dreamscape, you can re-examine the details of the puzzle whenever you wish. This seems to be a convenient feature prepared by Dr. Edward. He's so nice.

140340.item_bg_desc: While you are experiencing this Dreamscape, you can re-examine the details of the puzzle whenever you wish. This seems to be a convenient feature prepared by Dr. Edward. He's so nice.

140341.item_bg_desc: The ID belonging to Shamari, a worker of the Talent Motivation Department in the Interastral Peace Corporation. Most IPC staff value their ID greatly. Apparently, some have even "installed" it onto their forehead, ensuring that they can show it off to people wherever they go. Sparkle probably left it at the crime scene to prove that she really did assault someone.

140342.item_bg_desc: The giant wooden hammer Sparkle used to attack Shamari. It seems to be a custom-made model specifically for her. It is extremely heavy, and even Sampo can't lift it in one hand. What a herculean woman.

140343.item_bg_desc:
A copy of the Goldhammer Residence Security Regulations. Sparkle probably made it up on the spot just for this detective game. It says:
"To prevent criminals from hurting our great and lovely Miss Sparkle, the Goldhammer Residence shall abide by the following regulations from today onwards:
1. All retainers and visitors must enter and exit the Goldhammer Residence using the facial recognition system.
2. Those who cannot pass through the facial recognition system will be killed on the spot.
3. These regulations are in effect indefinitely."

140344.item_bg_desc: Apparently, one little press on this button will level all of Penacony. Who wouldn't want to try pressing it?

140345.item_bg_desc: An exquisite Pom-Pom toy. Who knows why Sparkle would have something like this... Maybe it's truly because the Conductor's beauty is famous throughout the cosmos?

140346.item_bg_desc: The account book of the rich merchant, Qian Ketong. For a merchant, it is probably something second-only in importance to money. Sparkle probably left it at the crime scene to prove that she really did assault someone.

140347.item_bg_desc: A couture tie. The label says "For Master Lefton's Use Only."

140348.item_bg_desc: A small stool with two small footprints drawn on it using a crayon, indicating it once belonged to a Pepeshi worker. This is perhaps the most crude out of all the "evidence"... Miss Sparkle had fallen from her pedestal.

140349.item_bg_desc: An expensive-looking ring. The words "Zhongshan's Heirloom" are carved on its side.

140350.item_bg_desc:
This "evidence" is obviously something comical Sparkle made. To avoid you thinking that you wasted time investigating this useless evidence, here's a recipe —
Smoke the red herring (or any other type of preserved fish) until it turns golden on both sides. Place it into a dish, remove all bones, then crush the meat. Add raw eggs into the frying pan and fry it until well done, then add vegetables you like and fry that too. Then, add in the crushed smoked red herring and day-old rice. Add some salt (be very careful with how much you put in! There's already preserved fish in it!), stir-fry evenly, then plate.
And voila! Here's a Smoked Red Herring Fried Rice.
You're welcome.

140351.item_bg_desc: It is hard to explain why a trashcan places its trust in you, but its trust feels remarkably heavy.

140352.item_bg_desc: An unusual dream bubble said to contain the dreams of Akivili, a fallen Aeon.\n\n"I'm sorry... I truly am the worst Nameless in the world."

140354.item_bg_desc: The heliobus possessing March 7th's camera. Pure and kind, they longs for the sceneries in the pictures that she took.\n\n"There's still so much I haven't done... so many sights I haven't seen..."

140355.item_bg_desc: Gifts sent by Guinaifen's enthusiastic, stalking fan.\n\n"Little Gui, you're really cool. I like you even more now!"

140356.item_bg_desc: A property deed faded with time. It is registered under Renault, an outworlder, which doesn't match the "Renault" you've encountered before.

140357.item_bg_desc: The commemorative medallion sent by Ghostly Grove to influencers attaining one million subscribers.\n\n"Congratulations, you have one million subscribers on Ghostly Grove!"

140358.item_bg_desc: The commemorative medallion sent by Ghostly Grove to influencers attaining one hundred thousand subscribers.\n\n"Congratulations, you have one hundred thousand subscribers on Ghostly Grove!"

140361.item_bg_desc: The specialized exorcism tool created by the Ten-Lords Commission for dealing with heliobi. It captures heliobi and locks them inside.\n\n"It can absorb the malevolent energy between heaven and earth, possessing the ability to ward off evil and avert calamity."

140362.item_bg_desc: The specialized exorcism tool created by the Ten-Lords Commission for dealing with heliobi. Ring the bell to resonate it with heliobi's illusory maze.\n\n"With resounding clarity, it purifies all directions."

140363.item_name: Fragmented Record of Belobog Ancient Martial Arts
140363.item_bg_desc: A ruined booklet. The pages are yellowish and fragile, and the notes written are extremely blurred. It is said that some of its text records some long-lost ancient Belobogian martial arts techniques.\n\n"I am almost certain that this booklet was made to look old by being fed to Funeral Worms before soaked in Moo-Moo urine... But the contents written upon its pages might very well be real, as certain contemporary texts can attest. Ah... Don't cry yet, let's get the appraisal fee settled first, thank you." — Balaway "Miner's Lamp"

140364.item_bg_desc: Recordings of a guqin being played at Swallowsong Pavilion. The recordingly can be played repeatedly.\n\n"Towering like that of a mountain, flowing like that of rapid water..."

140365.item_bg_desc: Recordings of a guqin music piece downloaded from the network. The recording can be played repeatedly.\n\n"An introduction for to-be guqin-lovers."

140366.item_bg_desc: A lodestone dropped from an unknown source. Life hack: You can use a lodestone to move metal objects on the other side of a piece of cardboard.

140367.item_bg_desc: Looks like a key to unlock a moon gate.

140370.item_bg_desc: Looks like a key to unlock a moon gate.

140372.item_bg_desc: A picture of a family of three. On it is written: "When we first arrived in Xianzhou — Renault." It seems to be dated about a hundred years ago...

140373.item_bg_desc: A stack of discarded, unused letter paper. The owner seems to have written a few pages before stopping, much like a sudden and transient enthusiasm for learning.

140374.item_bg_desc: Text obtained through rubbing the faint engravings on a stone monument to a piece of tracing paper. Appears to have been intentionally left behind by the homeowner.

140376.item_bg_desc: A square-shaped rice "ball" taken out of a lunchbox. Different foods are mixed together within. It might taste good?

140377.item_bg_desc: Broken weapon fragments, sharp enough to be used as a paper cutter.

140378.item_bg_desc: An old bell. It can produce a clear, crisp sound, and looks like an item used to attract small animals.

140380.item_bg_desc: A medicine exclusive to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, said to have the effect of improving overall fitness and rendering those who take it immune to all diseases for a short period of time. On the Yaoqing, legend holds that a healer who went by the surname of Yu fell in love with a foxian trader girl. But the Vidyadhara could live for a thousand years, much longer than the foxians. Yu searched for ways to release his lover from the grip of death. He fell for the trickery of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus and asked his lover to take the longevity medicine of Abundance without telling her what it was. The foxian girl turned into an abomination that no longer loved him before being slain by the Cloud Knights. To prevent Yu, who was overwhelmed by grief, from becoming mara-struck, the Alchemy Commission ordered him to take the Longevity Pill of Cruelty that deprived him of love and desire until his demise. The legend has another version, in which Yu was not of the Vidyadhara but a mere mortal, and the foxian girl was a spy planted by the Disciples to infiltrate the Alchemy Commission. This version is not as popular, for it turns a romance story into a political power struggle. "Those who love and live deeply fall into mara, while those who sever desire and passions can live for a millennium. Ask yourself, then, why fear mara, and why take joy in a long life?"
