140395.item_name: Emotion Prototype: The Moment of Betrayal
140395.item_bg_desc: You will always remember the trust and gentleness of that person, the persuasion and incitement from those people, and the surprised whisper from that person the moment you drew your dagger.\n\n"Et tu, my child?"

140396.item_name: Emotion Prototype: The Cloud of Doubt
140396.item_bg_desc: You sit up, a cloud of sadness forming in your mind. The words you have promised to others begin to falter. Are you really not a loser? Can you really achieve anything? Have you really chosen the right path?\nA fire ignites from the depths of your heart, and for one moment, tempting you to burn everything from the past to the ground.

140397.item_bg_desc: As you read this message, please consider the following advice: Send a message to your nemesis and tell them that you have forgiven them.\n\n"Our lives are too short to be wasted on feuds."

140398.item_bg_desc: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

140399.item_bg_desc: As the starship traverses the sky, leaving behind a trail of clouds, the IPC's pursuers disappear from sight. You exchange a high-five with your companions, feeling liberated from any constraints...\nThis is not the end. The looming threat of prison remains. It may be ten years or a hundred, but eventually, you will return to it. Until then, you can still savor a moment of freedom.

140400.item_bg_desc: This fragment appears to have been a part of a certain Dream Jigsaw.\nYou can feel from it a mixture of confusion, fear, grief, and an almost imperceptible determination to face death head-on.

140401.item_bg_desc: The meagre private funds of Firefly, a new artist of the Iris Family.\nUse it wisely. It's someone else's money, after all.

140402.item_bg_desc: The researchers' favorite work meal. It's not very fresh and not very clean. One wonders whether one will see the Aeons after eating it.

140403.item_bg_desc: Surveillance images provided by the security robot. It records the suspicious figure that recently approached the door security system.

140404.item_bg_desc: Data copied from the space station's terminal. It clearly and comprehensively records all external communication from the terminal.

140405.item_bg_desc: Fresh and tasty cake. Probably dropped by some unfortunate researcher.

140406.item_bg_desc: A manifestation of the emotion "Calm" in the Dreamscape. It can be used to repair people's Emo Dial and recover their lost emotions or memories.

140407.item_bg_desc: A manifestation of the emotion "Happy" in the Dreamscape. It can be used to repair people's Emo Dial and recover their lost emotions or memories.

140408.item_bg_desc: A manifestation of the emotion "Sad" in the Dreamscape. It can be used to repair people's Emo Dial and recover their lost emotions or memories.

140409.item_bg_desc: A manifestation of the emotion "Angry" in the Dreamscape. It can be used to repair people's Emo Dial and recover their lost emotions or memories.

140410.item_bg_desc: A petition calling on Lesley Dean's fans to enter the Dreamscape en masse and help him to "be reborn" through the Synesthesia Dreamscape.

140412.item_bg_desc: Evidence that Lesley Dean once gained a new lease of life.\n\n"Not even death could extinguish his radiance."

140414.item_bg_desc: A token of the Interastral Peace Corporation. You remember the envoy played a little trick with it.

140415.item_bg_desc: A luxurious private Steinway Falcon Speedster, featuring a low-profile black color.\n\n"Steinway Falcon Speedster: Making your dream come true faster!"

140416.item_bg_desc: A luxurious private Steinway Falcon Speedster. The most commonly rented model.\n\n"Steinway Falcon Speedster: Making your dream come true faster!"

140417.item_bg_desc: A luxurious private Steinway Falcon Speedster, featuring an extravagant golden color.\n\n"Steinway Falcon Speedster: Making your dream come true faster!"

140418.item_bg_desc: A luxurious private Steinway Falcon Speedster, featuring a stylish blue color.\n\n"Steinway Falcon Speedster: Making your dream come true faster!"

140419.item_bg_desc: The luxury "Utopon" unicycler, inspired by wind instruments, boasts an elegant design and provides a safe riding experience without having to worry about traffic jams!\n\n"Transform every one of your trips into an unforgettable journey."

140420.item_bg_desc: An old record tape discovered at the hotel in the Dreamscape, containing a single track titled "Envision a Rose Forthcoming."

140421.item_bg_desc: Bocchi's co-workers seem to have a grudge against him because they are forced to work overtime. Feinman seems to have something to do with this.

140422.item_bg_desc: A news article about a swindler being caught. I'm writing this down, although I don't know how Bocchi can be related to the case.

140423.item_bg_desc: Bocchi's "Precious Proposal." You're uncertain whether it'll see any use.

140424.item_bg_desc: A weird voicetape. A terrifying nightmare.

140425.item_name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (I)
140425.item_bg_desc: In the lobby of The Reverie, you encounter a father and daughter who seem to be searching for a long-lost relative in Penacony. Perhaps you will meet them again in Penacony's Dreamscape metropolis.

140426.item_name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (II)
140426.item_bg_desc: The father and daughter, seeking their relative's whereabouts in Penacony, inquire about a woman named "Charlotte the Dream Artist." A helpful banker informs them that artists in Penacony often gather in a restricted area known as the "Edge." Perhaps that will be their next destination.

140427.item_name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (III)
140427.item_bg_desc: Once more, you cross paths with the father and daughter at the Dream's Edge. They have yet to find Charlotte, however, they have discovered that Penacony's finest artists frequently assemble at The Reverie in the Dreamscape. Although the hotel in the Dreamscape is presently undergoing renovations, their determination remains unwavering as they plan to proceed there...

140428.item_name: Note: Searching for Mother in Dreamscape (IV)
140428.item_bg_desc: In the end, the father and daughter locate their long-lost wife and mother at the hotel in the Dreamscape. However, she refuses to reunite with her family. Following a heartrending conversation, the father and daughter leave the dream world in frustration, leaving you wondering if you will ever encounter them in reality...

140429.item_bg_desc:
The grand prize awarded by Dreamy Slots, but there are no instructions on how to use it.






...Well, for those who have read this far, it's unsightly to give you no hints. Let me tell you a secret: It's a room key.

140430.item_bg_desc: This shiny gold token appears to hold great value and can potentially be exchanged for an incredible super jackpot, but nobody in the Golden Hour knows how to use it.\nNevertheless, remember the words: "Promising Future."

140431.item_bg_desc: A mysterious medicine Screwllum handed to you. It may evoke the memories buried deep within Professor Chadwick's consciousness.

140432.item_bg_desc: This box contains eerie puzzle building blocks. It can be returned to the Dream Ticker Administrator.\nPuzzle blocks that make the Dream Tickers malfunction are sealed here, emitting an ominous aura.

140433.item_bg_desc: A part given to you by an Intellitron guest known as the "Ace Gambler." Its purpose remains a mystery.\n\n"Just carry it with you, even if as a talisman."

140434.item_bg_desc: A part given to you by an Intellitron guest known as the "Ace Gambler." It is said to contain a miniature transmitter that manipulates the outcome of the capsule machine, but it is no longer functional.\n\n"Don't frown all day. Put a smile on that face!"

140435.item_bg_desc: A special beverage given to you by Giovanna the dream nurse. It helps to suppress negative emotions and assists people in engaging with their normal jobs and lives.

140436.item_bg_desc: This is a part found in the ruins of the Pasdrak City Civic Center. Its original purpose is now impossible to discover. Swanga now carries this part with him at all times as a reminder to always recall the blood and tears of the revolutionaries.

140437.item_bg_desc: A delicately wrapped letter by Pom-Pom with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thank you for the gift, passenger {NICKNAME}!"

140438.item_bg_desc: A delicately wrapped letter by Dan Heng with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thank you for your gift. I like it."

140439.item_bg_desc: A delicately wrapped letter by Welt with a message expressing gratitude.\n\n"Thanks for the candy. I'll keep the rest for when we all come back to share."

140440.item_bg_desc: The parting gift from Black Swan. A tiny card numbered 'Zero,' seemingly absent from Black Swan's collection. In the card's art, she casts her gaze into the mist of destiny. "If one day you have unfortunately sunk into the Memory Zone's deep seas without a Memokeeper by yourself — it will guide you out on my behalf."

140441.item_name: Invite Received by the Annihilation Gang

140442.item_bg_desc: The entrance to the Dewlight Pavilion's Dreamscape Sandpit. Placing your hand through the small archway shrinks your body, and stepping out through the door in miniature state restores your original form. "The appearance of this thing reminds me of a tunnel that could shrink people with a single pass..." "If I were you, I would immediately shut your mouth. Don't say things that are not meant to be said."

140443.item_bg_desc: Pinball Machine Model. A miniature version of the Soulglad Candyball launcher found throughout the Sweetdream Paradise. "What would happen if I put a candyball into Soulglad?" "You can give it a try, but when the Bloodhound Family interrogates you, remember not to involve me in it."

140444.item_bg_desc: The cornerstone that only belongs to you. The Ten Stonehearts must cut their Cornerstone with their own will, allowing it to radiate its unique brilliance. Though shattered, the divine corpus of Qlipoth still shines for you. "All or nothing, it shall be."

140447.item_bg_desc: A baggage that only belongs to you. Filled with precious gems, it also serves as a tool for your tricky and elaborate magic trick. "Believing that you can trade these base and tacky jewels for everything — That's what gamblers excel at, isn't it?"

140449.item_bg_desc: A most exquisite scroll, holding a doctor's prescription within. Dr. Ratio advises you to only unveil it in a moment of life or death. "You look distressed. Is something troubling you? If so, you can figure it out yourself."

140450.item_bg_desc: A cute-looking button with an adorable design. Seemingly capable of triggering the complete annihilation of the other button holder, along with the entire Penacony — Can this be true? "For she is fair."

140451.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'El Dorado' in your honor, Dreamchaser —" "To golden dreams."

140452.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'The Premature Burial' in your honor, dreamer —" "To bringing time to a standstill."

140453.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'Dream Within Dream' in your honor, sober one —" "To our forebearers who dug their own graves."

140454.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'The Big Sleep' in your honor, lost sheep —" "Here's to the ghosts of the past."

140455.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'The Long Goodbye' in your honor, watcher —" "To a bitter childhood."

140456.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'Farewell, My Lovely' in your honor, seeker of truth —" "To unfinished business."

140457.item_name: Special Drink "A Ticket to the Boneyard"
140457.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'A Ticket to the Boneyard' in your honor, Nameless —" "To the dead and the dying."

140458.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'Even the Wicked' in your honor, Trailblazer —" "To the sad truth."

140459.item_name: Special Drink "Time to Murder and Create"
140459.item_bg_desc: A special concoction tailored exclusively for you by the drinksmith Gallagher. "Raise this glass of 'Time to Murder and Create' in your honor, innovator —" "To great vengeance."

140465.item_bg_desc: A photograph exclusively yours.\n\n"May your schemes be forever concealed."

140466.item_bg_desc: The reward for beating the game Hanu's Prison Break, capturing all of Hanu's highlights in the story. Perhaps similar scenes did happen in real history.

140468.item_bg_desc: This item is used to defend the legal rights of the great inventor Emmr... Ahem, well, to defend the legal rights of all creators in the cosmos.

140469.item_bg_desc: Extract emotions of "happiness" from passersby to fill in the missing aspects for the Dreamweaver's Emo Dial.

140470.item_bg_desc: Taking a peek into the immaculate bag, you see it's filled with ordinary toys. You cannot understand how they're selling so well. Perhaps this is what Oksana might call a return of "goodwill."

140471.item_bg_desc: This fragment appears to have been a part of a certain Dream Jigsaw.\nYou can feel from it a mixture of yearning and anticipation for the future.

140472.item_bg_desc: This fragment appears to have been a part of a certain Dream Jigsaw.\nYou can feel from it a mixture of yearning and anticipation for the future.

140476.item_bg_desc: This fragment appears to have been a part of a certain Dream Jigsaw.\nYou can feel from it a mixture of yearning and anticipation for the future.

140477.item_bg_desc: Sir Whittaker always kept the files containing information about the legendary Dreamweavers of the past.

140478.item_bg_desc: An old photograph. It looks dated, with four young figures printed on its faded yellow photo paper.

140479.item_bg_desc: A familiar photo bearing the images of four legendary Dreamweavers. You once used it to unlock Dr. Blues' heart.

140483.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's merchant, "Mr. Soda."\n\n*gurgle* Grab a bottle of SoulGlad, make your dreams a blast!

140484.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's Big Brother Hanu.\n\nAn extremely cool *hmph*.

140485.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's enemy, Boss Stone.\n\nWahaha, Dreamville is mine!

140486.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's builder, Origami Bird.\n\nTweet, make this small town bigger and more beautiful, tweet!

140487.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's savior, Old Man Wood.\n\n*cough cough* Everyone should love and respect each other, and more importantly, respect the rules.

140488.item_bg_desc: Contains the extra content of the animated film series Clockie: Dreamjoy Memoir, telling the story of Dreamville's Spheroid star, Hamster Ball Knight.\n\nLet's have a contest! Go go go go!

140489.item_bg_desc: Death is a bitter truth, but what you did will be remembered by history.

140490.item_bg_desc: The spirit of freedom will spread far and wide among the stars, and its legacy will be more timeless than a pastoral song.

140491.item_bg_desc: Miss Sparkle thoughtfully marked the locations of (five of the <unbreak>999</unbreak>) imaginary neutron bombs for you — she's just too kind!\nWhere are the rest of them, you ask? Just take a few strolls around on this luxury airship~

140492.item_bg_desc: A notebook lost by someone — its corners are yellowed and the majority of the notes within have been rendered incomprehensible by some kind of red rust-like stains.

140493.item_bg_desc: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"They said that the Dreamscape Ticker isn't the same as Clockie at all, just a scrapped early Clockie prototype..."

140494.item_bg_desc: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"Please... just leave me be, Clockie. I just don't know how to face you... because I'm just a failed product."

140495.item_bg_desc: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"I... I'll never be qualified to be the real you. Just give up, Clockie!"

140498.item_bg_desc: Made locally in Penacony, this television appears ordinary but is actually a commemorative TV set for Lil' Brother Hanu, allowing users to transform into Brother Hanu at any time and relive that wonderful adventure story.\n\n"Wishing you have fun, and may you never forget the deeds of Hanunue."

140499.item_bg_desc: A seemingly ordinary Aideen Token that contains the luck that Aventurine wishes to pass to you.\n\n"Using this coin, I won the capsule machine's grand prize seven times in a row. Hopefully, it can bring you good luck as well. — Aventurine"

140500.item_bg_desc: A miniature model based on the current Astral Express. A very expensive limited edition item paid for by Aventurine himself.\n\n"Here's a small token of congratulations to the Astral Express for obtaining the Radiant Feldspar — Aventurine"

140501.item_bg_desc: A boy's graffiti. The strokes are immature, yet time has not worn down the imagery of old dreams even a bit.\nHis faithful companion has put in a lot of effort for this.

140502.item_bg_desc: A premium gaming subscription service newly released by the Hex Club. Designed by Think-Tank, players can challenge "Hexanexus: Remake" and obtain rewards from various tiers.\n\n"Listen up. This is what sunk cost looks like."

140503.item_bg_desc: A mysterious note that seems to contain an encryption key and some ciphers.\n\n"The Ten-Lords Commission knows what these documents mean, of course. They just don't know where the contents will be used."

140507.item_bg_desc: A pendant decorated with a Slumbernana Monkey trinket, serving as a promotional reward for "Denisovan" level members. Proud members flaunt it on their phones, fanny packs, necks, or even faces.\n"Oh, by the way, 'Human' level members can accumulate pendant shards from the daily quiz and class attendance."

140508.item_bg_desc: This card has a golden slumbernana printed on it, signifying official membership of the Slumbernana Association. Whoever holds this card will be seen as a friend of all Slumbernana Monkey fans.\n"Rumor has it that only 0.6% of membership cards have a jadegreen banana printed on it, but members who have recruited over 90 fresh monkeys for the Association will always get that rare card."

140509.item_bg_desc: An enigmatic film reel given to you by Mr. Reca. The eye attached to it casts an unsettling and penetrating gaze, emanating a powerful obsession toward witnessing something. Entering another's Emoscape using this item allows you to capture the memories you have witnessed as audiovisual records.\n"Memories are movies without a montage, while movies are memories that have been edited. The former is raw material, and the latter is art refined from it. Regrettably, most of my colleagues fixate on the former, and are unable to create the latter..."

140510.item_name: Luofu Sports Illustrated — Special Edition for Luka's Final
140510.item_bg_desc: The special edition of Luofu Sports Illustrated, reporting on Luka's participation in the "Ringmaster's Challenge."\n\n"Swinging the next hit is always what's most important!"

140511.item_bg_desc: A bottle cap, purchased from the Dreamjolt Troupe for a high price. The fact remains that bottle caps are valuable even outside of nuclear wastelands.

140512.item_bg_desc: A special freebie for pre-ordering Slumbernana Monkey dolls, showcasing sub-par quality. Once the dolls arrive, the monkey dolls will autonomously follow the signal from this freebie to reach its purchaser. "Why do we give a lousy doll to the buyers first, BananAdvisor?" "1. To enhance the quality of the official doll. 2. To provide instant positive feedback upon their purchase. 3. To offer them a means to show off on social platforms before the goods arrive."

140513.item_bg_desc: A crest representing the benediction of Nikador — Titankins bearing this crest often proclaim their glory and invincibility in battle. \n\n"What a high drop rate! Thank you for your generosity, Nikador!"

140514.item_name: Group Photo of March 7th and the Crew
140514.item_desc: After using it in your Inventory, you can view the group photo.
140514.item_bg_desc: The group photo taken after March 7th won the Best Newcomer Award at the photography exhibition, with members of the Astral Express specially invited to appear.\n\n"The journey freezes into moments, moments weave into memories, and memories tell a story... The trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."

140515.item_desc: After using it in your Inventory, you can view the group photo.
140515.item_bg_desc: The group photo taken after March 7th won the Best Newcomer Award at the photography exhibition, with friends that helped during the exhibition specially invited to appear.\n\n"The journey freezes into moments, moments weave into memories, and memories tell a story... The trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."

140516.item_desc: After using it in your Inventory, you can view the group photo.

The Trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."

The trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."

140518.item_bg_desc: A camera lens gifted by Sparkle. To this day, you still are unsure of its exact use.\n\n"Transient and never repeating. Is capturing the vibrant scenes within the kaleidoscope merely a futile wishful thinking?"

140519.item_bg_desc: This memory of Castrum Kremnos comes from a bard, who praises the never-ending glory of the Strife Titan.

140520.item_bg_desc: This memory of Castrum Kremnos originates from the Grand Craftsman Chartonus, seemingly carrying with it the profound and weighty history of the Mountain Dwellers.

140521.item_bg_desc: This memory of Castrum Kremnos stems from an adventurer named Damionis, showcasing the golden era of the city's grandeur.

140522.item_bg_desc: A dream bubble gifted by Tingyun, which records your journeys on the Xianzhou. In this dream, the real Tingyun never missed out on meeting you.\n\n"The future is neither an initial meeting nor a reunion — We have always walked together."

140523.item_bg_desc: The cheapest food available — some of it already spoiled — but for the starving, there's no room for choice.

140524.item_bg_desc: Fresh food with simple, balanced nutrition. Commoners might tolerate it for a few meals, but for those on the brink of starvation, it tastes as sweet as honey.

140525.item_bg_desc: Exquisitely refined dishes, each a delicate masterpiece. An ordinary family may savor them for a week, while the starving would be swept straight to heaven with each bite.

140526.item_bg_desc: A trophy obtained after completing a mysterious challenge. If you listen carefully, you will hear some mournful mutters reverberating within the hollow skull.\n\n"This is what paradise is like: Those who know that it is a paradise cannot return. Those who do not know it is a paradise seek wonderland within its expanse."

140527.item_bg_desc: A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140528.item_bg_desc: A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140531.item_bg_desc: Strange crystals that store the power of Remembrance appear as you journey along. The light and shadows cast by the crystals seem to play out familiar scenes, and if you place them close to your ear, you can even hear the familiar whispers...

140532.item_bg_desc: Strange aquatic flowers, their sheen dazzling and warm.\nIt is said that they are tokens of the eternal vows between two revered deities.

140533.item_bg_desc: Strange aquatic flowers, their amber-colored soft flames sway imperceptibly.\nIt is said that they are tokens of the eternal vows between two revered deities, and now it holds the soul of one of them.

140534.item_name: Steel Claw Dagger with Faded Patterns
140534.item_bg_desc: A Steelclaw Dagger, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. Its grip shows signs of wear, with the patterns faded, giving it the look of an old blade.

140535.item_bg_desc: The Kremnos Shield, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. It just has a slightly dull coloration, giving it an aged appearance.

140536.item_bg_desc: A Kremnos Greatsword, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. Its blade appears to be fractured, as though it has been reforged.

140537.item_bg_desc: A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140538.item_bg_desc: A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140539.item_bg_desc: An ancient-looking torch, said to hold the last unextinguished cinders of Georios. When the long night descends, it might bring a glimmer of light to a world in darkness.\n\n"Heh, if you're afraid of the dark, just keep me by your side."

140540.item_bg_desc: A camera entrusted to you by your dear companion, March 7th. Taking her alias into account... Perhaps this camera is actually March 7th's true form. \n\n"Remember to take more photographs. I'll check on you!"

140541.item_bg_desc: A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.\n\n"Who knows what this might summon..."

140542.item_name: Artwork Nikador Battles the Rosy Celestial Maiden
140542.item_bg_desc: A painting from the Rosy Celestial Maiden series, released by an opportunistic art dealer. You can't help but chuckle upon seeing March 7th's dashing form as she fights in this painting.\n\n"Street stall art can never go out of style."

140543.item_bg_desc: An old photograph of the Kremnos Festival, taken by Damionis. Though slightly blurred, it still faintly captures the grand scale of the festival.

140544.item_bg_desc: Exceptionally pure redsoil feed, crafted with the ideal wet-to-dry ratio. It's the absolute favorite treat of dromases.

140545.item_bg_desc: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It's somewhat clotted.

140546.item_bg_desc: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It looks slightly dried up.

140547.item_bg_desc: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It smells a little sour.

140548.item_bg_desc: A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.\n\n"Who knows what this might summon..."

140549.item_bg_desc: A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.\n\n"Who knows what this might summon..."

140550.item_bg_desc: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking very valuable. What could it be?

140551.item_bg_desc: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking somewhat plain in appearance. What could it be?

140552.item_bg_desc: A slate that is hidden by Possephone within the cushion. Its contents appear to reveal why Hadez acted against her.

140553.item_bg_desc: A teleslate belonging to Possephone. From the memory you observed, it seems there was a glimmer of hope that Possephone could have escaped from Hadez.

140554.item_bg_desc: A tattered and torn scroll. Based on the memory you observed, it is a replica of the one Rhadaman used to trap the married couple.

140556.item_bg_desc: A stone seal that symbolizes one's identity as a priest of Janus. It can resound with and open the Gate of Infinity.

140557.item_desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
140557.item_bg_desc: A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage. "Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~" "...You already have a trophy."

140558.item_desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
140558.item_bg_desc: A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage. "Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~" "...You already have a trophy."

140559.item_bg_desc: A bloodied Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Nicomachus."

140560.item_bg_desc: A damaged Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Andreas."

140561.item_bg_desc: A Grove of Epiphany work permit wrinkled with sweat with the name "Clio."

140562.item_bg_desc: A grain that is quite ordinary in realms beyond the sky but uncommon in Amphoreus. The label on the specimen indicates it is the 330th generation of an experiment — perhaps the experiment has been ongoing for centuries. "During the breeding process, the crop's resistance to the black tide has significantly improved. The next step will attempt to enable the crops to absorb energy from the black tide and survive in lightless environments, challenging the conventional belief that no life can endure within the black tide."

140563.item_bg_desc: A seemingly unremarkable scroll filled with various equations and symbols, so complex that even the Synesthesia Beacon struggles to provide a reliable translation. "Self-reference is the most challenging problem — it not only strips mathematics of its completeness but also renders our souls enigmatic within the logical system." "This equation should hold true. I have an excellent proof... but alas, the space here is too tiny for it."

140564.item_bg_desc: It is said that this somewhat hazardous-looking powder helps participants in Titan-worship ceremonies attune their consciousness to the thoughts of the Titans. "So, what exactly is it made of?" "An unrefined plant-based sugar." "Huh? So eating it just means eating sugar?" "Yes. The ceremonies are quite lengthy, and fasting participants often struggle to endure due to low blood sugar." "..."

140565.item_bg_desc: The sword once wielded by Artakama, a Chrysos Heir scholar of the Grove. In the dire battle against the black tide, this sword stood steadfast by its master until her final breath. Following Artakama's demise, her younger sister, Cynane, picked up the sword and continued the fight until the ceaseless swarms of monsters devoured everything living.

140566.item_bg_desc: A rare Amphorean fine wine. It is said to be brewed from crops nourished by the divine blood of each Titan.\nThis particular bottle originates from the Chrysalis of Gold, Mnestia of Romance.

140567.item_bg_desc: A golden spindle that belongs to "Goldweaver" Aglaea. A legendary treasure.\n\n"Follow the golden thread, the love that contains all like the gods."

140568.item_bg_desc: A memorial medal issued by the Garden of Life to reward the sweat and tears shed by Chimera Squad that took the crown.\n\n"To the most diligent chimera. We hope to see growth and improvement in your future work!"

140569.item_bg_desc: The fallen soul of Oronyx the Time Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place, and its demigod will assume the authority of the vacant station after completing the trial.

140570.item_bg_desc: A handcrafted silver ring — if you hold it to your ear, you can hear the sound of melting snow. In Aidonia, the departed seal ice and snow into a ring before their final journey, offering it to the living as a token to walk the rest of the path in their stead. "When the ice melts and the snow fades, the flowers will bloom, and you will find me."

140571.item_name: Letter from the Phantom Thief Cipher
140571.item_bg_desc: A phantom thief's letter left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."\n\n"I fear it would attract tasteless little thieves, so I shall safeguard it for now."

140572.item_bg_desc: A coin left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."\n\n"Naturally, I've left appropriate payment — a single coin."

140573.item_bg_desc: Trianne secretly prepared a small gift for Castorice — a childlike drawing of the companions on their Flame-Chase Journey. Castorice perceptively noticed that it, and the memory it represents, would be the key to saving {NICKNAME} from the nether realm. "But Little Cas no longer has anything to fear now, because everyone is here with you in this Flame-Chase Journey!"

140574.item_bg_desc: The fallen soul of Thanatos the Death Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place. The demigod of Death has already overcome the trial and assumed the authority of the Titan.

140575.item_bg_desc: The memory entity you carried away from a dream, in some foreign land, an artisan who admired the King and carved a puppet with heartfelt reverence. Though it seems far removed from the real King, and the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired, what heroes pass down to later generations is often just like this — crude, yet enough to soothe the soul. "Besides, don't you think that, after staring at it for a while, it actually kind of feels full of soul?" "I think it's trying to suck my soul in!"

140576.item_bg_desc: An old, tattered photograph captures the past of Miss Note — the cries of injustice behind bars, the jubilant song upon breaking free, the thunderous applause beneath the stage, the scorn born of disgrace. All those voices have faded into history, leaving only a yellowed memory behind.\n\n"And even so, I still choose to sing."

140577.item_bg_desc: A Curio and Space Anchor from the world of Erudition that protects your individual data structure from the influences of digital tsunamis.\nWhen necessary, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.

140578.item_bg_desc: It was a distant wish, and also her blessing.

140579.item_bg_desc: Rich, intense, sweet.\n\nNot exactly sweet, but the contrast is obvious.

140580.item_bg_desc: The bottle contains the heroic souls of pomegranates who fought to their last breath. Drink it, and honor their journey.

140581.item_bg_desc: You can taste all the Amphorean fruits in this! Zero intoxication level, totally safe and worry-free!

140582.item_bg_desc: Don't worry. It just looks like water from the River of Souls... probably.

140583.item_bg_desc: Thoughts flowed like a fountain. By the time the pen stopped, only half a bottle of honey brew remained.

140584.item_bg_desc: Harvesting grape clouds at the intersection of Evernight for extraction and bottling... mysterious purple-tinted... plain drinking water.

140585.item_bg_desc: The kitty doesn't want to think about why this bottle of ambrosia has an exclamation mark in its name, and honestly, she has no clue either.

140586.item_bg_desc: The taste hits you like a punch to the face. Might be just what you need for healing wounds.

140587.item_bg_desc: Tides rise and fall, but the sound of waves remains eternal.

140588.item_bg_desc: Despite the oddly saccharine naming sense, the complimentary drinks in the Marmoreal Palace guest rooms taste just ordinarily sweet.

140589.item_bg_desc: An identification badge of the Flame-Chase Army, bearing the Imperator's highest command. The wearer has unrestricted access throughout the city.

140590.item_bg_desc: An unassuming ceramic cup, plain in craftsmanship. At that wanton feast, its cold rim passed her honey brew to your lips, branding you with the sin of exile, yet bestowing a dream of clarity in return.\n\n"The worth of a vessel lies in what it once held, and who once held it, just as blades earn legend by battle, and heroes are remembered through sacrifice."

140591.item_bg_desc: Phagousa was said to have buried twelve bottles of fine vintage beneath the seabed, hoping to savor them a thousand years later. But even as the black tide silenced the song of Chalice of Plenty, not a single drop had been uncorked.\n\nThis bottle, sweetest of the twelve vintages, was brought ashore by the last surviving sea siren. The divine power it holds can pierce through any fog.

140592.item_bg_desc: The Worldbearing Titan, Kephale's fallen soul. Yet seemingly some foreign force has tampered with them, making their divinity different from the one in the past Cycle. The Coreflame awaits its rightful return, through which the final Deliverer shall forge a new Era Nova.

140593.item_bg_desc: An identification badge of the Flame-Chase Army, bearing the Imperator's highest command. The wearer has unrestricted access throughout the city.

140594.item_bg_desc: An unassuming ceramic cup, plain in craftsmanship. At that wanton feast, its cold rim passed her honey brew to your lips, branding you with the sin of exile, yet bestowing a dream of clarity in return.\n\n"The worth of a vessel lies in what it once held, and who once held it, just as blades earn legend by battle, and heroes are remembered through sacrifice."

140595.item_bg_desc: Phagousa was said to have buried twelve bottles of fine vintage beneath the seabed, hoping to savor them a thousand years later. But even as the black tide silenced the song of Chalice of Plenty, not a single drop had been uncorked.\n\nThis bottle, sweetest of the twelve vintages, was brought ashore by the last surviving sea siren. The divine power it holds can pierce through any fog.

140596.item_bg_desc: A Curio. A Space Anchor in a world of Erudition. It can protect individual data structures from the influences of digital tsunamis.\nWhen necessary, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.

140597.item_bg_desc: A photo taken at an unknown time, but the reality of its touch is undeniable. In the past, this scene truly came to pass, leaving behind a proof of its transpiration. Though few are aware, a young girl will smile when she recalls a beautiful dream she once had. The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer. Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven. People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future. And then, walk toward tomorrow.

140598.item_bg_desc: You decide how memories are ultimately presented. When that beautiful dream ended, you immortalized Firefly in the way she longed for. The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer. Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven. People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future. And then, walk toward tomorrow.

140599.item_bg_desc: From the "Champion of Strife": Mydei's bestowal, symbolizing both his glory and restraint as a ruler and protector.

140600.item_bg_desc: From the "Trickery's Traveler": Cipher's bestowal, symbolizing her playful yet sincere blessings and desires.

140601.item_bg_desc: From the "Servant of the Afterlife": Castorice's bestowal, symbolizing the tenacity and peace she watches over on the other side.

140602.item_bg_desc: From the "Holy Child of Passage": Tribios's bestowal, symbolizing her unwavering faith and empathy throughout her journey in a thousand bodies.

140603.item_bg_desc: From the "Weaver of Romance": Aglaea's bestowal, symbolizing her unchanging selflessness and temperance beneath her aloof perfection.

140604.item_bg_desc: From the "Healer of the Sky": Hyacine's bestowal, symbolizing her gentle devotion and indiscriminate love for all of humanity.

140605.item_bg_desc: From the "Scholar of Reason": Anaxa's bestowal, symbolizing the enlightenment and critique he calmly left for future generations.

140606.item_bg_desc: To save the world, one must shoulder the burden of heavy wishes. Only by leaving it behind, can you absolve the obsession.

140607.item_bg_desc: To save the world, one must be accompanied by searing despair. Only by shattering it, can you absolve the obsession.

140608.item_bg_desc:
It was the New Year of the old calendar. That year, times were tough. The foxes couldn't afford to throw their feasts, the frogs didn't dare to sing, the monkeys stopped discussing flight, and the white rabbits hadn't passed through in ages.

But then it arrived.

A black rabbit.

Unlike those rabbits who couldn't care less about the moon, this one led its companions and gave the little animals here a hand.

...Ah, I should say, gave them a paw.

140609.item_bg_desc:
The black rabbit brought along many friends: some look human, while others look quite strange.

They aren't quite as level-headed as the black rabbit. Heated arguments are just part of their daily routine.

But when a foe appears, they immediately cast aside their differences and fight with total trust, following even the most questionable orders.

As they say, good people must stick together. Friends won't always see eye to eye, but they'll always help each other live a better life.

140610.item_bg_desc:
The foxes' prophecy came to pass. The flames of destruction ignited in the borderlands, sweeping all the way to the center of the world.

Many of the black rabbit's friends were sacrificed on the battlefield.

The frogs and monkeys were overcome with guilt, and no one was willing to sing at night anymore.

...But the black rabbit reached out its hand once again.

It said: "Stand up. You are worthy of singing your hearts out."

140611.item_bg_desc: The Phantasmoon New Game trophy will be awarded to every hero who offered their Wishpower to protect the Blue Planet!\n\n"A joyful ending like this is exactly what readers who celebrate life deserve!"

140613.item_name: Setting Sail Among the Stars Picture Book
140613.item_bg_desc: When we were kids, we all had countless "dreams." They didn't need to promise a hefty paycheck, nor were they bound by the cramped realities of life. They could be completely unreasonable, or entirely nonsensical... They were bold and fiery. They were the future we dared to proclaim to the world, hands planted firmly on our hips. As time passed, we all more or less parted ways with those first "dreams." We realized we lacked the talent, discovered that the reality of those dreams wasn't all that great, or learned that the weight of everyday life keeps us from reaching the stars. We might complain, we might harbor regrets, and we might grieve. But no one ever regrets having had a "dream" during those tender, beautiful days of childhood — a dream that forever encouraged them to set sail. This is the true meaning of a dream. And this is exactly why we must always safeguard a child's right to dream. "Open this picture book. Take a look at the future these children are so eager to leap into. May you find your younger self within these pages."

May you find your younger self within these pages."

140630.item_bg_desc:
Peace returned, and many years passed.

A few foxes still remembered the day the forest nearly fell to destruction, but the monkeys and frogs had long since come to take everything for granted.

The white rabbits remained nowhere to be found. The vows etched on the gravestones had blurred and faded in the acid rain.

The black rabbit once said that an ideal world should be one where the presence of good people is as thin as the air... One wonders if he foresaw that what could be as natural and imperceptible as air need not be kindness, but melancholy.

Malice always reeks. But nihility and beauty share the same absence: colorless, odorless, and utterly indistinguishable.

150010.item_bg_desc: A unique creation from Penacony, this syrup serves as a non-addictive tranquilizer, offering an ineffable experience of serenity and delight for a certain duration.\n\n"Its manufacturer claims this syrup has all the benefits of religion and alcohol without any of their drawbacks."

150011.item_bg_desc: When it comes to SoulGlad, classic means the best. Despite three attempts to modify the formula, the SoulGlad company was compelled to return to the original recipe due to complaints from dissatisfied customers each time.\n\n"Our double-blind tests show that over 70% of customers failed to discern the difference between the new formula and the original one."

150012.item_bg_desc: "One day, we will have a real house." With a cup of coffee in her hand, your wife says. "It will have a yard where we can grow flowers, a hall where we can dance, a transparent attic where we can gaze at the stars — and ideally, a small dog to cuddle and fall asleep with. That would truly be the truly blissful life." You smile in silence and propose a toast. The warm vapor swirls and ascends, gently caressing the ceiling before dissipating. "A bright future exists only in dreams."

150013.item_bg_desc: The poker game continued, reaching the fourth round. The man could not stop himself from checking his hand — his confidence had long since wavered. "A true gambler won't hesitate to call, even if the chances of winning are impossibly small..." The young man on the opposite side of the table snickered, pushing all his chips forward. "All in." "Being content is a virtue for mortals, whereas hesitation is a fatal flaw for gamblers."

150014.item_bg_desc: This soda made of fermented white grapes tastes both sour and bitter. It serves as an exceptionally revitalizing remedy for summer heat, and consuming it often results in sneezing and a runny nose. According to those who have tasted it, it feels like a cold hand pressed against your neck.\n\n"Pika... Ah-choo...!"

150015.item_bg_desc: "Insufficient active ingredient. Experiment failed." The scholar, frustrated by his 106,001st failure, randomly poked at the terminal. His mind was overwhelmed with worry, leading him to knock over the test tube rack on the table. The liquids from two unidentified containers mixed, releasing a pungent odor... "The 106,002nd attempt. Result: Successful."

150037.item_bg_desc: A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.\n\n"Please... just leave me be, Clockie. I just don't know how to face you... because I'm just a failed product."

150040.item_bg_desc: What does the taste of a sweet dream resemble? This question lacks a definitive answer. Hence, Dreamy Cones were introduced with an initial offering of over twenty distinct flavors. However, as time passed, only three prominent flavors endured, each representing a popular scenario found in dreams.\n\n"So, the three most popular scenarios are... memory loss, car crash, and terminal illness?"

150041.item_bg_desc: This burger earns its name from the crunchy disc-shaped flaky chip nestled between the buns, and only a few individuals can consume it in a dignified way. In certain taverns, devouring a Floatdisc Burger without using your hands has become somewhat of a legendary challenge.\n\n"Why is it that some Halovians always find fault with its appearance?"

150042.item_bg_desc: Resembling a clock, this pizza is precisely divided into twelve equal-sized slices, making it the perfect food for parties.\n\n"What is the meaning behind the unique shape of this food? Some believe it pays homage to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment."

150043.item_bg_desc: Strictly, the Potato Fries Sundae is not merely a food but a unique culinary experience that can only be realized within a dream world. In this realm, potato fries never go soft because of cooling down, and the ice cream never melts because of warming up. Cold and heat achieve perfect harmony here.\n\n"Finally, no more upset stomachs."

150044.item_bg_desc: Legend has it that poor inhabitants of border planets would add wood chips to their bread to satiate their hunger. Over time, this practice evolved into a peculiar tradition among aristocrats, symbolizing a "reverence" for the humble past. This product features a variety of botanical additives, closely resembling an oak branch in terms of both appearance and composition, and only the most ambitious and determined individuals can consume it. "Politicians from the Oak Family take pride in eating it without flinching, for they believe it to be a formidable feat."

150049.item_bg_desc: The prime suspect of this incident. She swore to completely melt every one of the cursed swords forged by her father, including Guyun.

150050.item_bg_desc: A Kalevalan envoy in charge of diplomatic affairs. He led a delegation to return the ancient sword, Guyun, to the Xianzhou. Though Yunli calls it a cursed sword, Paavo firmly believes Guyun to be the sword of a hero as told in the legends from his home.

150051.item_bg_desc: An artisan from the Artisanship Commission and the craftsman responsible for repairing Guyun. He checked on how Guyun was stored after you reminded him to keep the sword safe. Guyun was yet to be stolen at that time.

150052.item_bg_desc: The lock on the sword casket that Guyun was stored in. Given its intact lock, the thief either had the key to the casket or it was never locked to begin with.

150053.item_bg_desc: A rose petal that was caught in the hinge mechanism. You can only think of one person who would leave behind this ostentatious trace wherever he goes.

Influenced by Amphorean sagas of heroes, it presents itself in the current space-time as a golden apple. "To give civilizations to time, to give years their life."

150087.item_bg_desc: A scroll with prophecies inscribed. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

"Is it the legend-writers who become heroes, or must one first become a hero to write legends?"

150089.item_bg_desc: A 4-star certification from the Memchelin Gourmet Committee represents the highest recognition for a restaurant. To date, only one restaurant in the Membrance Maze has earned this prestigious honor.\n\n"Never forget, the purpose of cooking is to bring happiness to our diners."

150090.item_bg_desc: An award from the Memchelin Gourmet Committee is the ultimate proof of excellence that every restaurant dreams of.\n\n"Target: Memchelin 4-star!"

150091.item_bg_desc: A scroll with prophecies inscribed. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

150092.item_bg_desc: A scroll with prophecies inscribed. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.\n"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

150093.item_bg_desc: The Cosmicon Collective's Professional Certification, which indicates that the holder is recognized as having professional-grade dice mastery. Once obtained, you can swap different Prismatic Dice for your cards.

item_comefrom.desc: Increase Experience Level in the Cosmicon Collective gameplay to obtain

150094.item_bg_desc: It seems to be a work left behind by an unknown poet from ancient times, when poetry had not yet vanished from ancient Benzaitengoku.

150095.item_desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
150095.item_bg_desc: With the dust settled between "Cardway" and the "Mogura Gang," friends old and new got together to snap a photo. Fun fact: Everyone in the picture is a Cosmicon Collective pro, except for... "Except for Detective Passerby. He's clueless when it comes to cards." "Hey, was that really necessary? I... ugh, never mind."

150096.item_desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
150096.item_bg_desc: With the dust settled between "Cardway" and the "Mogura Gang," friends old and new got together to snap a photo. Fun fact: Everyone in the picture is a Cosmicon Collective pro, except for... "Except for Detective Passerby. He's clueless when it comes to cards." "Hey, was that really necessary? I... ugh, never mind."

150097.item_bg_desc: Page after page of dense legalese that'll put anyone to sleep just looking at it. Whatever, the money's already in hand, so nothing too crazy should pop up down the line... right? ...Right?

150098.item_bg_desc: From the Nameless who bridge the stars to the cute critters of The Fluffy and the heroes who saved the universe... they've gathered here for you, waving their glowsticks with hope and cheer.\n\n"In this vast universe, there are always people rooting for you. Never forget that, no matter where you go."

150099.item_bg_desc:
A slice of bread that's the perfect type, shape, size, and flavor to recreate that classic gag. Just pop it in your mouth and run through an intersection to trigger a dramatic encounter—it's practically a law of the universe.

"So that's your excuse for running into me!?"
"I said I was sorry, okay!?"

150100.item_bg_desc: The original prototype for the King Pom-Pom figure. In Fluffy Across the Blue, it's a powerhouse that puts most of the Nameless to shame. It comes with a full suite of cleaning, laundry, and sanitizing systems, making it more than a match for 99% of the universe's housework.\n\n"Pom-Pom is actually starting to feel a little threatened!"

150101.item_bg_desc: A Furbobo Weekly badge featuring artwork personally drawn by a famous comic artist, commemorating the Furbobo Weekly pop-up shop's victory as champion of Seafeld City's commercial district.\n\n"Aww, these teary-eyed little furbos are the cutest, don't you think?"

180001.item_bg_desc: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

item_comefrom.desc: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

180002.item_bg_desc: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

item_comefrom.desc: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

180004.item_bg_desc: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

item_comefrom.desc: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

180005.item_bg_desc: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

item_comefrom.desc: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

180006.item_bg_desc: Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

item_comefrom.desc: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

180007.item_bg_desc: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

item_comefrom.desc: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

180008.item_bg_desc: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.\n\n"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

180009.item_bg_desc: The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.\n\n"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

180010.item_bg_desc: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.\n\n"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies

180011.item_bg_desc: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies

180012.item_bg_desc: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.\n\n"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies

180013.item_bg_desc: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

item_comefrom.desc: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"

181001.item_bg_desc: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

item_comefrom.desc: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

181002.item_bg_desc: Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

item_comefrom.desc: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

181003.item_bg_desc: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

item_comefrom.desc: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station

181004.item_bg_desc: Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip. Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around. "The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

item_comefrom.desc: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

181005.item_bg_desc: Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

item_comefrom.desc: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies

181006.item_bg_desc: An electric ball made from captured lightning. If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball. "A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

item_comefrom.desc: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies

181007.item_bg_desc: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

item_comefrom.desc: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

181008.item_bg_desc: Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."

item_comefrom.desc: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies

181009.item_bg_desc: A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."

item_comefrom.desc: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies

181010.item_bg_desc: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

item_comefrom.desc: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI

181011.item_bg_desc: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.\n\n"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

181012.item_bg_desc: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.\n\n"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

181013.item_bg_desc: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.\n\n"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

181014.item_bg_desc: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.\n\n"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies

181015.item_bg_desc: In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible. In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death. "They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies

181016.item_bg_desc: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.\n\n"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies

181017.item_bg_desc: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. \n\n"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

item_comefrom.desc: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"

181018.item_bg_desc: Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. \n\n"Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

item_comefrom.desc: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"

182001.item_bg_desc: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

item_comefrom.desc: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies

182002.item_bg_desc: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

item_comefrom.desc: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies

182003.item_bg_desc: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

182004.item_bg_desc: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

item_comefrom.desc: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies

182005.item_bg_desc: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

item_comefrom.desc: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies

182006.item_bg_desc: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

item_comefrom.desc: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies

182007.item_bg_desc: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

item_comefrom.desc: Stargazer Navalia: Entranced Ingenium: Obedient Dracolion or other enemies

182008.item_bg_desc: At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound. In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads: "When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

182009.item_bg_desc: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies

182010.item_bg_desc: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.\n\n"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies

182011.item_bg_desc: A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.\n\n"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

item_comefrom.desc: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"

183001.item_bg_desc: The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."

item_comefrom.desc: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies

183002.item_bg_desc: Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change. What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame. "Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

item_comefrom.desc: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies

183003.item_bg_desc: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.\n\n"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

item_comefrom.desc: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies

183004.item_bg_desc: To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.\n\n"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

item_comefrom.desc: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies

183005.item_bg_desc: I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.\n\n"This is what is called 'weariness.'"

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies

183006.item_bg_desc: According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.\n\n"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

item_comefrom.desc: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies

183007.item_bg_desc: Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful. When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant. Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title. "Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?" "Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."

item_comefrom.desc: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
